ev_desc_era_flourish: {0} enters a Flourishing Era (army power up)
ev_desc_collapse: Economic Collapse! {0}'s wealth evaporates, citizens suffer
ev_desc_policy: Wealth redistribution policy adopted, wealth gap decreases
ev_desc_unrest_peace: Peace treaty with the rebels; unrest ends, kingdom recovers
ev_desc_unrest_resolved: Rebellion quelled, cities recaptured, kingdom recovers
ev_desc_policy_fail_civilwar: Reform failed! The kingdom falls into civil war
ev_desc_king_inherit: A new king ascends the throne
chart_legend_hint: Kingdom lines appear by rank: enter to show, fall to break, re-enter to resume
gini_legend_phase: Background bands = phase (green boom / orange recession / red depression / blue recovery)
gini_legend_danger: Red line = wealth gap danger line
gini_legend_health: Green line = wealth gap health line
picker_hint: Click a kingdom's Incite/Suppress buttons to act on that kingdom
rich_noworld: (No world loaded — enter a world, the list auto-refreshes yearly)
ui_language Description: UI language: auto = follow the game's language setting (default); or force zh / zh_tw / en / ru
unrest_enabled Description: Auto-detect high-wealth-gap kingdoms and trigger vanilla rebellion
log_worldlog Description: When ON, logs cycle wealth, kingdom wealth, unrest events, etc.
gini_threshold Description: Unrest triggers when wealth gap ≥ this value
unrest_grace_years Description: No unrest in the first N years
unrest_max_cities Description: Max cities rebelling per kingdom per outbreak; actual count is random and grows with the wealth gap (min 1)
policy_enabled Description: High-gap kingdoms auto-try wealth redistribution policy; may fail (ruler abdicates, dies, or the kingdom falls into civil war), success lowers the Gini index
cycle_enabled Description: Runs the 4-phase cycle; phase transitions are driven by the global wealth gap
cycle_gini_high Description: Gap ≥ this means imbalance (boom bursts to recession, recession to depression)
cycle_gini_low Description: Gap ≤ this means equality (depression/recovery move toward boom)
cycle_gini_periods Description: Cycles the gap must stay across the line before phase shifts (lower = faster cycles)
boom_stimulus_ratio Description: Coins injected per cycle as a share of GDP during boom (credit expansion)
boom_bubble_factor Description: Bubble accumulation speed during boom (injection × factor)
bubble_threshold Description: Bubble bursts and coins evaporate when accumulated value exceeds this
boom_max_duration Description: Boom shifts to recession after this many cycles
recession_max_duration Description: Recession shifts to depression after this many cycles
depression_max_duration Description: Depression shifts to recovery after this many cycles
recovery_max_duration Description: Recovery shifts to boom after this many cycles
survival_line Description: Economy turns depressed when average wealth falls below this
war_plunder_ratio Description: Share of the loser kingdom's coins plundered by the winner after a war
war_waste_ratio Description: Share of plunder that evaporates (war damage, not transferred). Deducted from the rich first, lowering the Gini coefficient
revolution_delay_years Description: A kingdom falls when its rebellion lasts this many years
revolution_kill_ratio Description: Share of the kingdom's population killed during a revolution
uprising_gini_threshold Description: After a rebellion, if the Gini stays at/above this for N years, a street uprising erupts (all-city revolt + kill the rich + overthrow the king)
uprising_delay_years Description: Years the Gini must stay above the uprising threshold after a rebellion before the regime collapses
kill_rich_ratio Description: Share of the kingdom's richest citizens executed during uprising/revolution (0.05 = top 5%)
kill_rich_redist_ratio Description: Share of executed rich citizens' wealth given to the poorest (rest evaporates/drops); higher cuts Gini faster
economy_collect_description: Manually run data collection and recalculation
wealth_tax_enabled Description: Each year taxes all citizens above the tax line and redistributes to the poor, steadily reducing the wealth gap
wealth_tax_ratio Description: Tax ratio on the amount above the tax line (0-0.5); higher reduces the gap faster
wealth_tax_line Description: Citizens with wealth above avg × this pay tax (1.0-3.0); those below avg × 0.8 receive subsidies
era_enabled Description: Golden Age / Revival / Flourishing / Collapse (triggered by rich spending or the cycle; citizens gain real bonuses)
era_duration_years Description: How long Golden Age / Revival / Flourishing last before auto-removal
collapse_drop_ratio Description: Collapse triggers when a kingdom's avg wealth drops ≥ this YoY during Depression
collapse_duration_years Description: How long Economic Collapse lasts before auto-removal
flourish_periods Description: Consecutive cycles meeting Flourishing conditions before triggering (debounce)
labor_enabled Description: Workers create wages each year by occupation productivity (labor creates wealth; the jobless produce nothing)
labor_wage_base Description: Annual wage = base × occupation multiplier (miner 1.3 / hunter 1.1 / farmer 1.0...)
real_time_refresh Description: Recalculate stats and refresh the HUD every N seconds (no wages/tax; keeps yearly cycle intact)
real_time_refresh_threshold Description: Skip recompute when alive units reach this (UI-only refresh) (100-100000, default 2000)
real_time_refresh_budget Description: Max alive units processed per lightweight refresh (100-100000, default 2000)
money_velocity Description: Money supply multiplier; higher = faster inflation transmission
inflation_bubble_boost Description: Bubble accumulation accelerates under high inflation
disaster_enabled Description: Disasters evaporate city wealth (population/city crash or hazard tile)
disaster_wealth_loss Description: Share of wealth lost in hit cities (0-0.8)
disaster_mine_bonus Description: Mining output bonus for hit areas during boom (0-1)
banking_enabled Description: The rich lend; in depression the default rate surges and contagion hits weaker kingdoms
credit_rate Description: Credit scale = rich wealth × credit rate (0.01-0.5)
crisis_contagion_threshold Description: When the default rate exceeds this value, contagion hits weaker kingdoms (0.05-0.5)
spending_cap_per_year Description: Max wealthy actors processed per year (default 5000, lower to throttle)
banking_default_cap_per_year Description: Max kingdoms processed for credit/defaults per year (default 500)
banking_contagion_cap_per_year Descripti: Max contagion partners evaluated per year (default 500)
frame_budget_ms Description: Max ms the annual closeout state machine advances per frame (1-100, default 4; snapshot/UI only after all stages)
cycle_window_ms Description: Total ms allowed for the whole annual closeout (100-10000, default 2000; on timeout extend to 5000ms first, then reduce spending->banking->other, tax never reduced)
inheritance_scan_per_frame Description: Max alive units scanned per frame in the 3-second inheritance window (default 2000)
perf_diagnostics_enabled Description: When ON, records closeout stage times (Stopwatch) and managed-memory deltas (GC.GetTotalMemory(false)); logs only over-budget stages plus one yearly summary. OFF = zero overhead (default)
cycle_alloc_budget Description: Per-cycle managed-allocation budget in KB (default 4096 = 4MB); the yearly summary flags a cycle whose total allocation delta exceeds this
memory_cleanup_enabled Description: When ON, trims static scratch/cache collections (TrimExcess) at intervals while the game is idle (default ON)
memory_cleanup_force_gc Description: Whether to run one System.GC.Collect when the cleanup interval fires (the only GC entry point in the mod; default OFF)
memory_cleanup_interval_seconds Descript: Minimum seconds between two automatic memory cleanups (5-300, default 30)
memory_cleanup_notify_enabled Descriptio: Shows a top-banner toast when an automatic memory cleanup frees a meaningful amount (default ON); the HUD memory status line and logs are unaffected by this switch
memory_cleanup_toast: Memory cleaned automatically: freed {0} MB ({1} buffers shrunk)
hud_mem_usage: Managed heap {0} MB | Unity used {1} MB (reserved {2} MB)
settling_hint: Annual settlement in progress: collection and phase switching are disabled
toast_policy_redistribute: [Policy] <{0}> enacted wealth redistribution; the gap is narrowing
toast_policy_tax_austerity: [Policy] <{0}> raised taxes to replenish the treasury
toast_policy_fiscal_fail: [Policy] <{0}> failed to pass its fiscal policy; unrest grows
toast_policy_fail_civilwar: [Policy] <{0}> reform failed! The kingdom falls into civil war
toast_uprising: [Uprising] <{0}> street uprising! {1} rich executed, the king is overthrown
toast_unrest_peace: [Unrest] <{0}> peace negotiated with rebels; order restored
toast_unrest_resolved: [Unrest] <{0}> revolt quelled, cities reclaimed; order restored
toast_bubble_burst: [Economy] Bubble bursts! {0} of wealth evaporates, {1} affected
toast_banking_crisis: [Economy] Banking crisis! Depression defaults spread to {0} kingdoms, {1} gold lost
toast_disaster: [Economy] Disaster strikes! {0} cities hit, {1} gold evaporates
ev_desc_policy_fail_fiscal: Reform failed! The fiscal policy was not enacted

cabinet_no_nation: You have not claimed a nation yet
cabinet_claim_hint: Pick a kingdom to serve as its economy minister
cabinet_build_title: Construct buildings (own cities, one per city)
cabinet_no_cities: Your nation has no cities yet
toast_nation_claim: [Cabinet] You are now the economy minister of <{0}>, treasury {1} gold
toast_nation_unbind: [Cabinet] <{0}> has fallen; you step down as minister
toast_nation_destroyed_war: [Cabinet] War has destroyed a building of {0}!
toast_nation_destroyed_disaster: [Cabinet] Disaster has destroyed a building of {0}!
toast_nation_no_slot: [Cabinet] Policy slots full ({0}); cancel one first
toast_nation_built_already: [Cabinet] This city already has a building
toast_nation_build_unavailable: [Cabinet] No matching building asset in this game version
toast_nation_build_failed: [Cabinet] Construction failed; funds returned to treasury
nation_play_enabled Description: Enable central banker gameplay: claim a nation, royal treasury, ongoing policies and one-shot decrees (default ON)
treasury_income_ratio Description: Percent of own city warehouse gold levied into the royal treasury each cycle (1-20, default 5)
toast_dip_peace_poor: [Diplomacy] Treasury cannot afford the peace terms
nation_claim_hotkey Description: Hover a kingdom on the map and press this key to claim/open the cabinet panel (Unity KeyCode name, e.g. G; blank disables; default G)
ui_scale Description: Overall scale of the cabinet panel font and buttons (0.8-1.6, default 1.2); takes effect immediately
cabinet_policy_hint: Ongoing policies occupy slots; enabling pays the first year, retiering pays a reform fee, cancelling is free
cabinet_decree_hint: One-shot decrees are instant; buildings are one per city and can be destroyed by wars and disasters
cabinet_diplomacy_hint: Real-time actions against a target: war/peace/alliance/pact/gift; 2 pact slots
toast_nation_place_mode: [Cabinet] Click your territory to place: {0} (right-click cancels)
toast_nation_place_territory: [Cabinet] Must be placed inside your nation
cabinet_place_hint: Pick a building to enter placement mode: click your territory to build, right-click to cancel
cabinet_gdp_chart_short: Not enough GDP data yet - the curve appears after a few cycles
ev_treasury_gap_desc: The treasury is nearly empty; the ministers argue over a blank ledger.
ev_treasury_gap_res1: The emergency tax has been collected into the treasury.
ev_treasury_gap_res2: The treasury sits empty; grumbling spreads among the people.
ev_tax_corruption_desc: The collectors skim; less gold reaches the treasury each year.
ev_tax_corruption_res1: The corrupt were purged; the crown's standing rose.
ev_tax_corruption_res2: The crown shares the spoils; discontent simmers.
ev_rich_petition_desc: Rich merchants offer gold for trading privileges.
ev_rich_petition_res1: Gold flows in; the merchants celebrate.
ev_rich_petition_res2: The petition is rejected; the merchants grow cold to the crown.
ev_drought_desc: The land cracks; grain prices climb daily.
ev_drought_res1: Granary grain is handed out; the people survive.
ev_drought_res2: The altars are built and torn down; no rain, only anger.
ev_locust_desc: A swarm blots out the sun; the fields are stripped.
ev_locust_res1: Every household hunts locusts; the blight is contained.
ev_locust_res2: The swarm leaves nothing; hunger spreads in the villages.
ev_quake_aftermath_desc: Aftershocks continue; rumors of doom spread.
ev_quake_aftermath_res1: Paid repairs rebuild homes and calm the people.
ev_quake_aftermath_res2: The ruins are ignored; rumors grow wilder.
ev_royal_wedding_desc: A royal wedding approaches; the steward brings two budgets.
ev_royal_wedding_res1: The feast impresses every court; envoys fill the gates.
ev_royal_wedding_res2: The modest rites leave the courts unimpressed.
ev_minister_power_desc: A minister packs the courts; decrees bear his seal alone.
ev_minister_power_res1: Power returns to the crown; the minister's faction seethes.
ev_minister_power_res2: The minister still rules; every court knows whose word goes.
ev_succession_dispute_desc: The succession is disputed; two factions deadlock.
ev_succession_dispute_opt2: Back the worthier, buy off the rest
ev_succession_dispute_res1: The elder heir prevails; the losing faction broods.
ev_succession_dispute_res2: Gold settles the dispute—at the treasury's expense.
ev_army_pay_desc: The frontier army is owed months of pay; envoys press for gold.
ev_army_pay_res1: The army is paid in full; morale soars.
ev_army_pay_res2: Pay is postponed again; grumbling fills the camps.
ev_mercenary_default_desc: Hired mercenaries demand back-pay at the worst moment.
ev_mercenary_default_res1: The debt is settled; the mercenaries stand down.
ev_mercenary_default_res2: Disbanded, the mercenaries turn to brigandage.
ev_prisoner_ransom_desc: The enemy offers ransom for captive nobles—or we may buy our own back.
ev_prisoner_ransom_res1: The captives come home; tensions ease a little.
ev_prisoner_ransom_res2: The ransom is refused; the enemy vows revenge.
ev_bread_riot_desc: Bread prices soar; a crowd gathers at the granary gates.
ev_bread_riot_res1: Grain is sold at fair prices; the streets calm down.
ev_bread_riot_res2: The crowd is dispersed; the anger is not.
ev_plague_desc: Plague spreads in the next province; physicians ask to act early.
ev_plague_res1: Physicians are funded; the plague stays outside.
ev_plague_res2: The gates are shut; trade withers.
ev_neighbor_extort_desc: A strong neighbor demands tribute—pay, or they will patrol the border.
ev_neighbor_extort_res1: The tribute is paid; the neighbor quiets down—for now.
ev_neighbor_extort_res2: The envoy is expelled; the border heats up.
ev_marriage_alliance_desc: A neighbor proposes a marriage alliance.
ev_marriage_alliance_res1: The marriage binds the two courts; envoys never cease.
event_choice_countdown: {0} year(s) left, then the cautious option is taken
toast_event_pending: A decision awaits the kingdom — open the Cabinet.
event_chance_player Description: Yearly chance of a decision event for your claimed kingdom (0-1; 0 disables).
event_chance_ai Description: Yearly chance for AI kingdoms (0-1); they decide by national character and the result lands in the event feed.
event_cooldown_years Description: Minimum years between any two kingdom events (1-10).
ev_treasury_gap_opt1_desc: Levy a one-off emergency tax on all residents to refill the treasury.
ev_treasury_gap_opt2_desc: Do nothing and tighten belts — unrest will grow.
ev_tax_corruption_opt1_desc: Purge the collectors; the crown pays for the investigation but honor is restored.
ev_tax_corruption_opt2_desc: Let them skim; the treasury nets more — corruption takes root.
ev_rich_petition_opt1_desc: Take the gold and grant the merchants their monopoly.
ev_rich_petition_opt2_desc: Reject the petition and fine the ringleaders.
ev_drought_opt1_desc: Open the granaries to feed the people — it will cost the treasury.
ev_drought_opt2_desc: Save the grain and let the people fend for themselves.
ev_locust_opt1_desc: Pay households in grain to hunt the locusts.
ev_locust_opt2_desc: Ignore it and leave the harvest to fate.
ev_quake_aftermath_opt1_desc: Fund paid repair works to rebuild homes and roads.
ev_quake_aftermath_opt2_desc: Release no funds; let the rumors die on their own.
ev_royal_wedding_opt1_desc: Throw a lavish feast the whole world will remember.
ev_royal_wedding_opt2_desc: Keep the rites modest but proper.
ev_minister_power_opt1_desc: Move against the minister and purge his faction.
ev_minister_power_opt2_desc: Leave things be to avoid shaking the court.
ev_succession_dispute_opt1_desc: Follow tradition and crown the elder heir.
ev_succession_dispute_opt2_desc: Pick the worthier heir and buy off the rest.
ev_army_pay_opt1_desc: Pay the arrears in full and steady the army.
ev_army_pay_opt2_desc: Keep delaying; the gold stays in the treasury.
ev_mercenary_default_opt1_desc: Honor the contract and keep the veterans.
ev_mercenary_default_opt2_desc: Disband them and save the wages.
ev_prisoner_ransom_opt1_desc: Pay the ransom and bring our people home.
ev_bread_riot_opt1_desc: Open the granaries and sell grain at fair prices.
ev_plague_opt1_desc: Fund physicians and medicine to keep the plague outside.
ev_plague_opt2_desc: Seal the gates and spend nothing.
ev_neighbor_extort_opt1_desc: Pay the tribute and buy peace.
ev_neighbor_extort_opt2_desc: Refuse outright — war if it must be.
ev_marriage_alliance_opt1_desc: Accept the marriage and bind the strong neighbor by blood.
ev_merchant_loan_desc: An envoy brings an offer: the merchant league will lend {kingdom} a fortune — no loan comes free.
ev_merchant_loan_opt1_desc: Take the gold now; repay with interest in two years.
ev_merchant_loan_res1: The gold is in; {king} sealed the contract.
ev_merchant_loan_opt2_desc: No foreign debts; {kingdom} minds its own purse.
ev_merchant_loan_res2: The offer is declined; {king} says {kingdom} owes no favors.
ev_loan_due_desc: Two years are up; the league collectors stand at the palace gates, and {king} must answer.
ev_loan_due_opt1_desc: Bleed the treasury but keep the crown's credit.
ev_loan_due_res1: The debt is paid with interest; {kingdom}'s credit grew.
ev_loan_due_opt2_desc: Tear up the contract and eat the scorn of every court.
ev_loan_due_res2: The contract is torn up publicly; merchants everywhere remember {kingdom}.
ev_tax_farm_desc: A magnate offers three years of taxes up front to farm the collectors — good ledger, risky hearts.
ev_tax_farm_opt1_desc: Take the gold now; the resentment arrives later.
ev_tax_farm_res1: Three years of tax fill the vault; curses fill the streets.
ev_tax_farm_opt2_desc: The collectors stay under the crown, coin by coin.
ev_tax_farm_res2: The deal is refused; the crown keeps clean hands.
ev_war_bonds_desc: The war strains the purse: issue bonds to the people, redeem on victory.
ev_war_bonds_opt1_desc: The people subscribe eagerly; the war chest fills.
ev_war_bonds_res1: The bonds buy supplies; morale at the front soars.
ev_war_bonds_opt2_desc: No debts to the people; the war purse is cut to the bone.
ev_war_bonds_res2: The thin purse breeds grumbling in camp.
ev_land_survey_desc: The treasury asks leave to survey every field; hidden land, hidden tax — no more.
ev_land_survey_opt1_desc: Pay the surveyors now; next year the tax base is honest.
ev_land_survey_res1: The survey is done; hidden taxes flow to the vault.
ev_land_survey_opt2_desc: Too great a stir — {king} leaves the old ledgers alone.
ev_land_survey_res2: The survey is shelved; the old ledgers stay a muddle.
ev_guild_bank_desc: The craft guilds want a lending bank and offer the crown a share.
ev_guild_bank_opt1_desc: Invest and take dividends — and share the guilds' boat.
ev_guild_bank_res1: The bank opens; the crown collects yearly.
ev_guild_bank_opt2_desc: Keep the crown's name off moneylending; comfort the poor instead.
ev_guild_bank_res2: The crown declines and turns to charity instead.
ev_flood_desc: Days of rain; the river swallows the lowland villages.
ev_flood_opt1_desc: Put every hand on the dikes to save the lowlands.
ev_flood_res1: The dikes hold; the flood recedes and {kingdom} keeps its homes.
ev_flood_opt2_desc: The displaced scatter, carrying anger to every city.
ev_flood_res2: The flood leaves ruins and grudge on the banks.
ev_wildfire_desc: Dry winds push the wildfire toward villages and timber.
ev_wildfire_opt1_desc: Pay woodcutters to cut firebreaks and save the timber.
ev_wildfire_res1: The firebreaks stop the flames; the timber survives.
ev_wildfire_opt2_desc: Spend nothing; let the fire burn out.
ev_wildfire_res2: The burn leaves ash fields and weeping villagers.
ev_blizzard_desc: The blizzard kills herds and blocks the grain roads.
ev_blizzard_opt1_desc: Lend grain for the winter, repay in spring.
ev_blizzard_res1: The winter is survived; the grain returns in spring.
ev_blizzard_opt2_desc: Save the grain; count the frozen instead.
ev_blizzard_res2: When the snow stops, every village mourns.
ev_mine_collapse_desc: The mine caves in at night; families crowd the pit mouth.
ev_mine_collapse_opt1_desc: Spare no coin digging and comfort the widows.
ev_mine_collapse_res1: Most miners are pulled out alive; {kingdom} is praised.
ev_mine_collapse_opt2_desc: Abandon the trapped to save the seam.
ev_mine_collapse_res2: When the pit is sealed, the weeping lasts three days.
ev_river_dry_desc: The river fails; wheels stop and rice fields crack.
ev_river_dry_opt1_desc: Put crews on a channel from the upper waters.
ev_river_dry_res1: The channel runs; the rice fields live.
ev_river_dry_opt2_desc: Plant hardy crops — half the harvest, no expense.
ev_river_dry_res2: The dry fields yield half; the villages endure.
ev_rockslide_desc: After days of rain, a slide buries the pass on the trade road.
ev_rockslide_opt1_desc: Pay stonecutters to clear the pass quickly.
ev_rockslide_res1: The pass reopens to passing praise.
ev_rockslide_opt2_desc: Save the coin; caravans detour ten days.
ev_rockslide_res2: The detour costs ten days and the tolls shrink.
ev_heir_plot_desc: Secret word: {king}'s heir courts the generals. The blade is halfway from its sheath.
ev_heir_plot_opt1_desc: Arrest him at once — the court trembles, but the threat dies today.
ev_heir_plot_res1: The plot is crushed with an iron hand.
ev_heir_plot_opt2_desc: Gold and honors to feed his ambition.
ev_heir_plot_res2: Gold quiets the heir — for now.
ev_heir_plot_opt3_desc: Feign blindness and set the net; never startle the snake.
ev_heir_plot_res3: {king} watches and waits; the net is set.
ev_heir_plot_crushed_desc: The heir's faction is broken, but his men remain in every office. What now?
ev_heir_plot_crushed_opt1_desc: Confiscate across the board; the treasury swells.
ev_heir_plot_crushed_res1: The seized estates fill the treasury.
ev_heir_plot_crushed_opt2_desc: Punish only the chiefs; mercy earns gratitude.
ev_heir_plot_crushed_res2: Mercy is remembered in every court.
ev_concubine_rivalry_desc: Two consorts feud openly; the quarrels reach the throne room.
ev_concubine_rivalry_opt1_desc: Gifts for both — an uneasy peace.
ev_concubine_rivalry_res1: The harem quiets; the vault feels lighter.
ev_concubine_rivalry_opt2_desc: Demote and fine them both; restore order.
ev_royal_astrologer_desc: The astrologer reads a great omen in the stars — for a price to build the altar.
ev_royal_astrologer_opt1_desc: Better safe than sorry — pay for peace of mind.
ev_royal_astrologer_res1: The altar stands; all say heaven favors {kingdom}.
ev_royal_astrologer_opt2_desc: Call it sorcery and banish him; scholars cheer, priests seethe.
ev_royal_astrologer_res2: The astrologer is gone; the stargazers mind their tongues.
ev_hunt_accident_desc: At the autumn hunt, {king}'s horse bolts and tramples a commoner — before a crowd.
ev_hunt_accident_opt1_desc: A royal funeral, rich compensation, and {king} bows to the family.
ev_hunt_accident_opt2: By the letter of the law
ev_hunt_accident_opt2_desc: Let the magistrates pay the standard sum.
ev_hunt_accident_res2: The law is followed — no anger, no applause.
ev_hunt_accident_opt3_desc: Disperse the crowd and bury the story.
ev_hunt_accident_res3: The story is buried — but the hoofbeats are remembered.
ev_old_regent_desc: The old regent who ruled for years asks leave to retire home — the court holds its breath.
ev_old_regent_opt1_desc: Gold, honors, and a grand farewell.
ev_old_regent_res1: The old man leaves in tears; every court praises {king}'s grace.
ev_old_regent_opt2_desc: Reclaim the reins; the old man's grudge runs deep.
ev_old_regent_res2: Power returns to the crown — and a grudge to the court.
ev_bastard_claim_desc: A young man with an old token claims {king}'s blood and a place in the line.
ev_bastard_claim_opt1_desc: Verify and acknowledge him — the name and the scandal together.
ev_bastard_claim_res1: He is acknowledged; the markets buzz.
ev_bastard_claim_opt2_desc: Denounce the token as forged and drive him out.
ev_bastard_claim_res2: He is expelled, crying injustice at the gates.
ev_spy_ring_desc: The inner court proposes a spy ring over envoys and ministers.
ev_spy_ring_opt1_desc: Pay for ears everywhere; all lands whisper to {king}.
ev_spy_ring_res1: The ears are everywhere; {king} hears first.
ev_spy_ring_opt2_desc: The crown acts in daylight; spies are beneath {kingdom}.
ev_spy_ring_res2: The proposal dies; {king} keeps one line uncrossed.
ev_war_defector_desc: A veteran general defects with secrets — and intentions nobody can read.
ev_war_defector_opt1_desc: Execute him before the lines; the enemy will shudder.
ev_war_defector_res1: The execution chills the enemy army.
ev_war_defector_opt2_desc: Honor him and take his talents — with his heart untested.
ev_war_defector_res2: {king} greets the defector at the command tent.
ev_war_defector_opt3_desc: Refuse the defector; keep the honor clean.
ev_war_defector_res3: Sent away with honors; both armies call {king} old-fashioned honorable.
ev_defector_ambition_desc: The defector has grown his own power and obeys reluctantly. The old seed sprouts.
ev_defector_ambition_opt1_desc: Pay any price to break his command for good.
ev_defector_ambition_res1: His command is broken; the danger ends.
ev_defector_ambition_opt2_desc: A purge risks civil strife — endure for now.
ev_defector_ambition_res2: The calm holds — and everyone sees the crack.
ev_supply_convoy_desc: The supply convoy is ambushed; the escort begs for reinforcements.
ev_supply_convoy_opt1_desc: Pull men from the city to guard the grain roads.
ev_supply_convoy_res1: The roads reopen; the front steadies.
ev_supply_convoy_opt2_desc: Refuse and wish the convoy luck.
ev_supply_convoy_res2: The convoy is hit again; the front starves three days.
ev_fort_rebuild_desc: The border fort is falling apart; the warden asks to rebuild.
ev_fort_rebuild_opt1_desc: Pour gold into the bastion; the border sleeps easy.
ev_fort_rebuild_res1: The fort stands new; the border sleeps.
ev_fort_rebuild_opt2_desc: Border works can wait; spend elsewhere.
ev_fort_rebuild_res2: The fort stays broken; the border hears wolves at night.
ev_veteran_company_desc: Old soldiers ask to form a standing veteran company — for ordinary pay.
ev_veteran_company_opt1_desc: Pay them and let the veterans hold the border.
ev_veteran_company_res1: The veterans hold the border; banditry dies.
ev_veteran_company_opt2_desc: The purse is thin; send the old soldiers home.
ev_veteran_company_res2: The veterans go home; the taverns gain old war stories.
ev_privateer_licence_desc: A pirate chief offers gold for a privateer licence to prey on enemy shipping.
ev_privateer_licence_opt1_desc: Take the gold; {kingdom}'s seas gain licensed wolves.
ev_privateer_licence_res1: The privateers sail; gold and notoriety arrive together.
ev_privateer_licence_opt2_desc: Refuse and burn their ships as an example.
ev_privateer_licence_res2: The pirate ships burn like torches; the sea lanes are clean.
ev_hero_funeral_desc: The old warden of the border has died; the nation mourns and debates the rites.
ev_hero_funeral_opt1_desc: A full state funeral at the crown's expense.
ev_hero_funeral_res1: The whole nation lines the streets; envoys attend.
ev_hero_funeral_opt2_desc: Honor his will: a simple grave.
ev_hero_funeral_res2: The old general sleeps in a nameless grave — remembered anyway.
ev_market_fire_desc: A night fire guts half the market; the merchants lose everything.
ev_market_fire_res1: The new market opens busier than before.
ev_market_fire_opt2_desc: The merchants rebuild alone; the crown pays nothing.
ev_market_fire_res2: A shabby market returns; merchants sigh at tax time.
ev_water_shortage_desc: A dry summer empties the wells; lines form daily in the city.
ev_water_shortage_opt1_desc: Pay wellmasters to dig deep and channel water.
ev_water_shortage_res1: Sweet water reaches the city; the shortage ends.
ev_water_shortage_opt2_desc: Ration by household — cheap, but unpopular.
ev_water_shortage_res2: Rations cut the queues and raised the complaints.
ev_tenant_strike_desc: Rents rose once too often; the tenants refuse to pay and the estates sue.
ev_tenant_strike_opt1_desc: The crown leans on the landlords to cut rents.
ev_tenant_strike_res1: Rents are cut; the tenants cheer.
ev_tenant_strike_opt2_desc: Send officers to collect; law first.
ev_tenant_strike_res2: The rents arrive in full — and so do the cold stares.
ev_festival_request_desc: The people petition {king}: a good harvest deserves a city-wide festival.
ev_festival_request_res1: Three days of feasting; all speak well of {king}.
ev_festival_request_opt2_desc: Good times can wait; save for the bad ones.
ev_festival_request_res2: The petition is declined; the streets call {king} stingy.
ev_night_patrol_desc: Thieves rule the night; shops are robbed nightly and the guilds demand patrols.
ev_night_patrol_opt1_desc: Pay for a night watch and give the shops their sleep.
ev_night_patrol_res1: The watch walks; thieves vanish and shops rest.
ev_night_patrol_opt2_desc: The shops hire their own guards; the crown pays nothing.
ev_night_patrol_res2: Scattered guards lose to organized thieves.
ev_bathhouse_fad_desc: A bathhouse craze sweeps the city; the guilds ask the crown to champion more.
ev_bathhouse_fad_opt1_desc: Champion the baths; health for the whole city.
ev_bathhouse_fad_res1: Baths everywhere; {kingdom} is famous for cleanliness.
ev_bathhouse_fad_opt2_desc: The crown doesn't chase fashions; they fade.
ev_bathhouse_fad_res2: The fad fades; a few baths struggle on.
ev_traveling_fair_desc: A traveling fair rolls into the city, asking leave to trade under crown tax.
ev_traveling_fair_opt1_desc: Permit the fair and take the crown share.
ev_traveling_fair_res1: A fortnight of fair — taxes and cheers together.
ev_traveling_fair_opt2_desc: Fear the disorder; turn the fair away.
ev_traveling_fair_res2: The fair moves to the neighbor; the streets of {kingdom} feel quieter.
ev_royal_visit_desc: A neighboring royal house announces a visit — the pomp must match theirs.
ev_royal_visit_opt1_desc: Full state honors; guest and host delight.
ev_royal_visit_res1: A perfect visit, told fondly in every court.
ev_royal_visit_opt2_desc: Protocol by the book — polite, never lavish.
ev_royal_visit_res2: Correct but cold; the guests leave unimpressed.
ev_hostage_request_desc: A strong alliance demands a royal hostage as proof of friendship.
ev_hostage_request_opt1_desc: Send royal blood abroad for the alliance's ease — the palace weeps.
ev_hostage_request_res1: The hostage departs; the pact hardens, the palace grieves.
ev_hostage_request_opt2_desc: Plead the child's tender years; the ally loses face.
ev_hostage_request_res2: The refusal spreads; the ally takes offense.
ev_border_treaty_desc: The neighbor proposes a border treaty with fixed markers — an end to feuds.
ev_border_treaty_opt1_desc: Cede the disputed strip for a century of peace.
ev_border_treaty_res1: The markers stand; border brawls end.
ev_border_treaty_opt2_desc: Not an inch of the ancestors' land; double the border watch.
ev_border_treaty_res2: The talks collapse; the outposts eye each other.
ev_pirate_bribe_desc: The pirates send terms: pay, and {kingdom}'s ships sail safe.
ev_pirate_bribe_opt1_desc: Pay the toll; the ships fly the safe-passage flag.
ev_pirate_bribe_res1: The toll paid; {kingdom}'s ships sail untouched.
ev_pirate_bribe_res2: Several pirate bands fall; the rest remember.
ev_pilgrim_wave_desc: Word of miracles draws pilgrims to the borders of {kingdom}.
ev_pilgrim_wave_opt1_desc: Wayside shelters and soup for the pilgrims passing through.
ev_pilgrim_wave_res1: The pilgrims bless {kingdom} far and wide.
ev_pilgrim_wave_opt2_desc: Fear the crowds; close the border and turn them away.
ev_pilgrim_wave_res2: The pilgrims are turned away — and the holy fame with them.
ev_tribute_envoy_desc: A small far kingdom sends tribute and asks for {kingdom}'s protection.
ev_tribute_envoy_opt1_desc: Take the gifts — and the obligations of a protector.
ev_tribute_envoy_res1: The tribute is stored; the duty is written on {kingdom}.
ev_tribute_envoy_opt2_desc: Take nothing from the small; treat them as equals.
ev_tribute_envoy_res2: The tribute is declined; the small kingdom respects {kingdom} all the more.
toast_event_chain: An earlier choice bears new fruit — {kingdom} faces a fresh decision.
bank_disabled_note: (Banking is disabled in settings; this page is display-only.)
ev_caravan_ambush_desc: {king}'s caravan is ambushed at the border; the trade roads are afraid.
ev_caravan_ambush_opt1_desc: Hire escorts along the roads; trade steadies at once.
ev_caravan_ambush_res1: Escorts ride out; caravans move and markets relax.
ev_caravan_ambush_opt2_desc: No guarantees; the trade roads suffer for two years.
ev_caravan_ambush_res2: The roads stay cut; the slump is blamed on {kingdom}.
ev_trade_route_cut_desc: Half a year of cut routes: shops run dry, taxes shrink. {king} pays to reopen or holds firm.
ev_trade_route_cut_opt1_desc: Grease the right palms; the routes reopen.
ev_trade_route_cut_res1: The routes reopen; commerce tax recovers.
ev_trade_route_cut_opt2_desc: The land detour is slow and dear — but no one is paid off.
ev_trade_route_cut_res2: The land routes hold on barely; commerce stays above zero.
ev_bank_run_desc: Defaults spread and depositors storm the banks. Reserves run dry — {king} must act now.
ev_bank_run_opt1_desc: Fill the reserves from the crown vault and buy back confidence.
ev_bank_run_res1: The bailout calms the run; the market breathes again.
ev_bank_run_opt2_desc: Save the vault, not the banks — and watch the anger snowball.
ev_bank_run_res2: Bank failures erupt; the streets fill with furious depositors.
ev_bank_run_aftermath_desc: The run is over but trust is shattered. How will {king} mend it?
ev_bank_run_aftermath_opt1_desc: Spend gold to relief the ruined depositors.
ev_bank_run_aftermath_res1: The ruined regain faith; the market warms again.
ev_bank_run_aftermath_opt2_desc: No interference; time heals all ledgers.
ev_bank_run_aftermath_res2: The healing is slow; {kingdom}'s credit scar remains.
ev_guild_petition2_desc: The guilds petition {king} for franchise rights — and offer heavy gold.
ev_guild_petition2_opt1_desc: Take the gold and grant the rights; the rich gain, the poor lose.
ev_guild_petition2_res1: The franchise is granted; taxes soar, so do the grumbles.
ev_guild_petition2_opt2_desc: Keep the market fair; decline the deal.
ev_guild_petition2_res2: The petition is declined; guilds sulk, the people approve.
bank_enabled Description: Enable the banking & commerce system (city ledgers, central-bank panel, commerce tax, bank-run risk)
bank_money_supply_factor Description: Share of net loan growth added to the money supply (0-0.5); drives inflation and bubbles
bank_max_loans_per_city Description: Cap on active loans per city (keeps the ledger bounded)
bank_deposit_ratio_default Description: Share of resident wealth deposited into city banks yearly (0-30)
ruler_personality_enabled Description: Enable ruler personality: reads vanilla king traits and personality stats to sway AI law evolution, policy success, treasury skimming and event choices (parliament dampens)
ev_loan_recovery_desc: The debt is settled, but {king}'s credit is still to be rebuilt — the league tentatively sends a new contract.
ev_loan_recovery_opt1_desc: Borrow again at a favorable rate and roll the credit.
ev_loan_recovery_res1: The pact is signed; the merchant world re-acknowledges {kingdom}'s credit.
ev_loan_recovery_res2: The refusal earns {kingdom} fresh respect in the merchant world.
ev_heir_legacy_desc: The dust settles, but {king} must name a new heir — the court holds its breath again.
ev_heir_legacy_opt1_desc: By tradition; stable, yet the factions still squabble.
ev_heir_legacy_res1: The elder heir is crowned; the foundation firms.
ev_heir_legacy_opt2_desc: Against tradition — controversy and cost together.
ev_heir_legacy_res2: The worthy rules; governance renews, old ministers grumble.
ev_defector_rebellion_desc: Enduring for years, the defector finally raises his banner — the tolerated seed grew into a plague.
ev_defector_rebellion_opt1_desc: The crown crushes the revolt at full strength.
ev_defector_rebellion_res1: The rebellion falls; {kingdom} wins fear in one battle.
ev_defector_rebellion_opt2_desc: Buy off his followers with rank and gold.
ev_defector_rebellion_res2: The wedge works; the rebels dissolve — costly, but strength is kept.
ev_royal_heist_desc: A brazen band tunneled into the vault — the ingots have vanished.
ev_royal_heist_opt1_desc: A heavy bounty; dig every hole.
ev_royal_heist_res1: The thieves are caught; most loot returns.
ev_royal_heist_opt2_desc: Suppress the news to keep calm — the loss is small, the face big.
ev_royal_heist_res2: The news is buried, but the court lives in alarm ever after.
ev_mint_shortage_desc: The mint cannot keep up; copper coins run short and barter returns.
ev_mint_shortage_opt1_desc: The crown buys copper and mints to ease the market.
ev_volcano_eruption_desc: The volcano erupts; ash blots the sun; nearby villages cry for help.
ev_volcano_eruption_opt1_desc: Open the granaries and shelter the displaced.
ev_volcano_eruption_res2: The ash settles, but the displaced beg at every gate.
ev_plague_second_desc: The plague thought quelled erupts again, fiercer than before.
ev_plague_second_opt1_desc: Fund new infirmaries and seal the zone.
ev_plague_second_res1: The zone is contained; public-health reputation rises.
ev_plague_second_opt2_desc: No new funds; let it burn itself out.
ev_plague_second_res2: The plague rages; gloom blankets {kingdom}'s cities.
ev_cult_rise_desc: A new sect preaches doom; believers multiply and temples glow.
ev_cult_rise_opt1_desc: Legalize it in exchange for donations and calm.
ev_cult_rise_res1: Their gold enters the vault; their creed seeps into the edicts.
ev_cult_rise_opt2_desc: Proscribe it and tear down the temples.
ev_cult_rise_res2: Outlawed, but the believers go underground.
ev_cult_aftermath_desc: The sect is judged, but its followers are scattered — how to recover?
ev_cult_aftermath_res1: Under amnesty, the scattered believers return to the fields.
ev_cult_aftermath_opt2_desc: Register them but shadow every household.
ev_cult_aftermath_res2: Under the watch, the sect finds no new life.
ev_princess_betrothal_desc: A neighbor seeks the hand of a princess, offering rich gifts for the marriage bond.
ev_princess_betrothal_opt1_desc: A grand procession; the two courts become kin.
ev_princess_betrothal_res1: The marriage wins {kingdom} a powerful ally.
ev_princess_betrothal_opt2_desc: Plead youth or health and decline.
ev_princess_betrothal_res2: The suit refused; the envoy leaves chagrined.
ev_border_skirmish_desc: A border outpost clashes; both sides blame each other; war looms.
ev_border_skirmish_opt1_desc: Rebuke the officer, pull back a step, calm it.
ev_border_skirmish_res1: Restraint earns a verbal apology; the matter cools.
ev_border_skirmish_opt2_desc: Send troops to scour the border and demand justice.
ev_border_skirmish_res2: The border tenses; both sides mass troops.
ev_war_escalation_desc: The friction escalates; armies face off; caravans detour.
ev_war_escalation_opt1_desc: Order the army and open the war.
ev_war_escalation_res1: The first strike buys the initiative; the war favors {kingdom}.
ev_war_escalation_opt2_desc: Send envoys to beat swords into ploughshares.
ev_war_escalation_res2: Both yield a step at the table; the war stays unlit.
ev_armory_explosion_desc: The armory erupts at night; flames and heavy casualties.
ev_armory_explosion_opt1_desc: Fund a rebuild and strengthen the guard.
ev_armory_explosion_opt2_desc: Punish negligence harshly as a warning.
ev_armory_explosion_res2: Artisans jailed; the ordinance of arms turns stern.
ev_city_fire_desc: A blaze at midnight engulfs half the city quarter.
ev_city_fire_opt1_desc: Call the mob to raze a firebreak and fight.
ev_city_fire_res1: The flames are stopped; most of the quarter survives.
ev_city_fire_opt2_desc: Seal the zone and let it burn.
ev_city_fire_res2: The blaze burns all night; charred bodies lie about.
ev_refugee_wave_desc: Neighboring war drives refugees to {kingdom}'s borders, without food or clothes.
ev_refugee_wave_opt1_desc: Set up shelters, distribute gruel, register them.
ev_refugee_wave_res1: The refugees settle; population and goodwill grow.
ev_refugee_wave_opt2_desc: Close the gates and escort them out.
ev_refugee_wave_res2: The refugees scatter; the neighbor's young population never returns.
ev_ally_betrayal_desc: A former ally secretly links with {kingdom}'s enemy; the pact is intercepted.
ev_ally_betrayal_res1: The severance rocks the courts; {kingdom}'s firmness wins fear and respect.
ev_ally_betrayal_opt2_desc: Say nothing; quietly hedge the alliance terms as leverage.
ev_ally_betrayal_res2: Restraint steadies the situation, but the wound of trust does not heal.
ev_secret_negotiation_desc: A third power sends a secret envoy to {king}, offering a clandestine friendship on rich terms.
ev_secret_negotiation_opt1_desc: Agree secretly for gains and intelligence.
ev_secret_negotiation_res1: The pact holds; {kingdom} gains a friend in the shadows.
ev_secret_negotiation_opt2_desc: No deals with shadow powers; refuse sternly.
ev_secret_negotiation_res2: The envoy is expelled; the third power bears a grudge.
ev_embezzle_ring_desc: The vault count uncovers an embezzling ring—the shortfall touches royal kin, and {king} fumes yet treads softly.
ev_embezzle_ring_opt1_desc: For the kin's sake, shelve the case for another day.
ev_embezzle_ring_res1: The shortfall stays unclaimed; the moths bore even deeper.
ev_embezzle_ring_opt2_desc: Spend freely: push the probe, recover the gold.
ev_embezzle_ring_res2: The moths are caught, but costs ran high—{kingdom}'s vault loses another sum.
ev_toll_rebellion_desc: Toll posts crowd the roads, each one skinning travelers—across the realm of {kingdom}, carters murmur of mutiny.
ev_toll_rebellion_opt1_desc: Crush the carters' unrest and keep the toll income.
ev_toll_rebellion_res1: Repression breeds more defiance; the toll posts slide into chaos.
ev_toll_rebellion_opt2_desc: Spend from the vault to buy out the posts and reopen the roads.
ev_toll_rebellion_res2: The posts fall; {kingdom}'s trade roads run free, though the treasury paid dearly.
ev_debt_auction_desc: The vault runs dry; merchants propose a state bond—if {king} nods, the market may scramble to subscribe.
ev_debt_auction_opt1_desc: Open subscriptions wide; the highest bidder wins and silver flows in.
ev_debt_auction_res1: The bonds sell out; the vault of {kingdom} fills at once.
ev_debt_auction_opt2_desc: No new debt; better to live within the old accounts.
ev_debt_auction_res2: The plan is shelved; merchants murmur, and the vault stays as it was.
ev_specie_crisis_desc: Coins turn debased and shops refuse them; money tightens in {kingdom} and prices reel.
ev_specie_crisis_opt1_desc: Open the vault, release silver, redeem coins, settle the market.
ev_specie_crisis_res1: The market calms, yet {kingdom}'s silver is thereby reduced.
ev_specie_crisis_opt2_desc: Edict it: all shops must accept the coins, or face harsh penalty.
ev_specie_crisis_res2: The edict fails; merchants and folk rail, and the market grows wilder.
ev_bank_discount_desc: A great banking house will lend to foreign merchants at low rates—if {king} puts the seal upon a guarantee.
ev_bank_discount_opt1_desc: The seal endorses it; the bank rebates, and travelers rejoice.
ev_bank_discount_res1: Bills run free across borders; other courts look far more kindly on {kingdom}.
ev_bank_discount_opt2_desc: No state guarantee; better to keep things as they are.
ev_bank_discount_res2: The house is crestfallen—yet no storm rises, nor any sun.
ev_salt_law_desc: Salt merchants dodge the levy; the ministry proposes a salt monopoly—the yes or no rests on {king} alone.
ev_salt_law_opt1_desc: License the salt trade; the folk pay a coin or two more.
ev_salt_law_res1: The salt profits flow to the crown; the vault of {kingdom} swells.
ev_salt_law_opt2_desc: Levy the salt tax on every mouth, young and old.
ev_salt_law_res2: The tax stirs wrath; salters and merchants quietly resist.
ev_liquor_law_desc: Breweries crowd the land yet yield no tax; the ministry proposes a liquor code—levy or ban, awaits {king}.
ev_liquor_law_opt1_desc: Official brewing and selling; the levy into the public purse.
ev_liquor_law_res1: The liquor levy thrives; the coffers of {kingdom} turn rich.
ev_liquor_law_opt2_desc: Seal the breweries; punish home-brewing severely.
ev_liquor_law_res2: The ban falls; breweries gather and howl, complaints flood the roads.
ev_iron_law_desc: Iron is the root of farm and war—an iron office or free trade, one edict of {king} decides.
ev_iron_law_opt1_desc: Iron trading channels through the crown; private dealers fined hard.
ev_iron_law_res1: Iron profits pass to the crown; the state finances of {kingdom} ease a little.
ev_iron_law_opt2_desc: Open the iron roads; farm and war prosper everywhere.
ev_iron_law_res2: Iron flows to every border; merchants praise {kingdom} to the skies.
ev_currency_ruin_desc: Bad coin drives out good; the market refuses the state money, and by the time {king} hears of it the rot has gone deep.
ev_currency_ruin_opt1_desc: Throw gold from the vault, call in bad coin, restrike the money.
ev_currency_ruin_res1: The vault pours out gold, and prices still startle—this affair, it seems, is far from over.
ev_currency_ruin_opt2_desc: Let the market find its own price; the crown will not interfere.
ev_currency_ruin_res2: Lamentation floods the streets—the coin calamity may be a mere prologue.
ev_mint_clampdown_desc: The wellspring of bad coin is still open—private furnaces bloom everywhere, and {king} is set on cleansing them.
ev_mint_clampdown_opt1_desc: Death for private minting; accomplices bound by the same rope.
ev_mint_clampdown_res1: The law strikes, and resentment follows; under the surface the market stirs.
ev_mint_clampdown_opt2_desc: Pay to absorb the private furnaces and feed their artisans.
ev_mint_clampdown_res2: The furnaces die down, but {kingdom} pays another tidy sum.
ev_customs_raise_desc: Port tariffs have festered for years; the ministry proposes a rise—to enrich the state or wound its friendships, {king} must weigh.
ev_customs_raise_opt1_desc: Every ship that berths pays a new levy on its cargo.
ev_customs_raise_res1: The duties pour in; the vault of {kingdom} grows fat.
ev_customs_raise_opt2_desc: New checkpoints everywhere, foreign merchants harassed at every turn.
ev_customs_raise_res2: Traders rail aloud; the nations eye {kingdom} with sudden contempt.
ev_treasury_moth_desc: The books never match the stores; custodian clerks pilfer at every hand, the deficit snowballs—{king}'s vault is being devoured bite by bite.
ev_treasury_moth_opt1_desc: Hire honest clerks to count everything and claw the sums back.
ev_treasury_moth_res1: The probe runs deep and the public purse bleeds—yet the hole remains unfilled.
ev_treasury_moth_opt2_desc: Feign ignorance and keep the dusty ledgers as they are.
ev_treasury_moth_res2: The moths grow fat; the folk begin to murmur, and gossip boils over.
ev_war_debt_desc: War supplies lie unpaid in mountains—the front cries for wages, creditors crowd the very gates.
ev_war_debt_opt1_desc: Sell the privy fund, scrape it together, settle every account.
ev_war_debt_res1: The debts are cleared; the vault of {kingdom} stands bare.
ev_war_debt_opt2_desc: Tell the creditors to hold their patience—we shall discuss it.
ev_war_debt_res2: Unpaid wages and debts together—the camp's fury nears open mutiny.
ev_subsidy_cut_desc: The marches lean on yearly gifts from {kingdom}; cutting them now—sever the allies, or tighten the own belt first?
ev_subsidy_cut_opt1_desc: Trim the gifts to allies and save the public purse.
ev_subsidy_cut_res1: The nations bristle; envoys storm out, and the prestige of {kingdom} takes a blow.
ev_subsidy_cut_opt2_desc: Cut the relief granary and workshop subsidies.
ev_subsidy_cut_res2: The soup kitchens stand empty; the hungry crowd the market, their fury deafening.
ev_trade_house_rise_desc: A mighty trading house will fund bridges and roads—for the boon of one charter from {king}.
ev_trade_house_rise_opt1_desc: Give the banner and the license; the house spreads its wings.
ev_trade_house_rise_res1: The roads run free; travelers from every nation sing the praises of {kingdom}.
ev_trade_house_rise_opt2_desc: The state will not chase merchant profit; all stays as before.
ev_trade_house_rise_res2: The great merchant leaves chagrined; the market stays calm, sighs only lingering.
ev_usury_ring_desc: Farmers throughout {kingdom} are snared in usurious notes, and their towers of debt grow taller by the day.
ev_usury_ring_opt1_desc: Let the interest run; the crown neither hears nor asks.
ev_usury_ring_res1: Creditors hammer the gates; children and daughters are sold, and resentment knots ever tighter.
ev_usury_ring_opt2_desc: License the trade; the crown takes its customary cut.
ev_usury_ring_res2: The interest flows in—an unlooked windfall fills the vault of {kingdom}.
ev_granary_speculation_desc: Grain prices soar; the granaries hold and wait to sell—a scorching deal now lies before {king}.
ev_granary_speculation_opt1_desc: Sell the old grain while prices peak; get it in the bag.
ev_granary_speculation_res1: The old stores clear out; the vault of {kingdom} thickens.
ev_granary_speculation_opt2_desc: Big merchants hoard; the crown folds its arms.
ev_granary_speculation_res2: Rice prices leap thrice a day; the hungry fill the streets, cursing to the heavens.
ev_ferry_tax_desc: The river crossings of {kingdom} weigh a ferry toll—boatmen and travelers hold their breath.
ev_ferry_tax_opt1_desc: Official ferry posts; one cent added to every passage.
ev_ferry_tax_res1: The toll enters the purse; the chest of {kingdom} gains a little.
ev_ferry_tax_opt2_desc: Under the tax's name, squeeze the boatmen again and again.
ev_ferry_tax_res2: The boatmen stop sailing; travelers from every neighbor turn bitter against {kingdom}.
ev_market_margin_desc: Brokers jack up prices in the market; two charters lie before {king}: to calm the folk or to fill the purse.
ev_market_margin_opt1_desc: Official prices; no broker may inflate them.
ev_market_margin_res1: Prices hold steady; traders from every quarter praise {kingdom} for fairness.
ev_market_margin_opt2_desc: Rents from every stall into the state, booked and tallied.
ev_market_margin_res2: The market dues grow; the vault of {kingdom} rises a touch.
ev_tax_reform_court_desc: In the hall of {king}, the roar over merging and recasting the taxes threatens to lift the roof.
ev_tax_reform_court_opt1_desc: Merge the levies, spread them over the fields, and do it fast.
ev_tax_reform_court_res1: Revenue soars, yet the countryside groans and the tax chasers prowl like tigers.
ev_tax_reform_court_opt2_desc: The quarrel stands; leave it for next year.
ev_tax_reform_court_res2: The new tax founders; the vault looks as before, and the court quiets.
ev_royal_mint_debase_desc: A secret memorial from the mint reaches {king}: clip three parts from every coin—what is there to fear of an empty vault?
ev_royal_mint_debase_opt1_desc: Secret orders to lighten the coin; new money minted in great tides.
ev_royal_mint_debase_res1: The mint margin is fat; the vault of {kingdom} balloons.
ev_royal_mint_debase_opt2_desc: Rather an empty vault than a coin of less than full weight.
ev_royal_mint_debase_res2: The coin stands true, but the officials' wages fall in arrears and grumbling begins.
ev_savings_hunt_desc: A minister submits a Hoard-Digging Plan: silver lies buried by the thousands in the homes of {kingdom}—dig and be rich.
ev_savings_hunt_opt1_desc: Follow the map, dig up the silver, and carry it to the vault.
ev_savings_hunt_res1: Hoards are dug up; the stores of {kingdom} leap suddenly higher.
ev_savings_hunt_opt2_desc: Borrow forcibly from the merchants, promised back within fixed days.
ev_savings_hunt_res2: The merchants seethe; the trading world casts sidelong eyes at {kingdom}.
ev_wage_freeze_desc: Wages in the workshops climb daily; the ministry petitions a freeze—hard on the craftsmen, or a boon to {kingdom}?
ev_wage_freeze_opt1_desc: Wages fixed for three years; violation punished hard.
ev_wage_freeze_res1: The craftsmen grow restless; the workshops show early signs of stalling.
ev_wage_freeze_opt2_desc: Let wages follow the market; no official hand.
ev_wage_freeze_res2: Wages nudge up; the workshops are at ease, no storms either way.
ev_gdp_boom_report_desc: The ministry of agriculture reports: granaries full, money and grain up—how does {king} settle this report of fine times?
ev_gdp_boom_report_opt1_desc: Carve it in stone and send the couriers to every neighbor.
ev_gdp_boom_report_res1: The nations hasten to congratulate, praising {kingdom} for wise governance.
ev_gdp_boom_report_opt2_desc: Impose a celebration levy; the whole realm feasts.
ev_gdp_boom_report_res2: The festival turns lavish; the folk grumble at the waste, and gossip stirs.
ev_land_sale_urgent_desc: The treasury calls for rescue; the ministry petitions sale of crown lands near the capital—once sold, {kingdom} loses a slice of income forever.
ev_land_sale_urgent_opt1_desc: A generous price; silver reaches the vault at once.
ev_land_sale_urgent_res1: The land changes hands; the vault of {kingdom} is pulled from the brink.
ev_land_sale_urgent_opt2_desc: Ancestral land is not lightly sold; seek another way.
ev_land_sale_urgent_res2: The sale is dropped; the treasury remains bare-grained, and other paths must be sought.
ev_prize_fund_desc: The war office would fund rewards for valor; the treasury says the chest is bare. Between the two, {king} sits long in silence.
ev_prize_fund_opt1_desc: Draw silver from the purse to lavish valor.
ev_prize_fund_res1: The gold goes out; the army jubilates, the chest a little thinner.
ev_prize_fund_opt2_desc: Not a coin: only carved plaques and honorary titles.
ev_prize_fund_res2: The nations hear of it and praise {kingdom}'s grace to the brave.
ev_customs_leak_desc: Smuggling vessels weave like shuttles; the customs of {kingdom} leak through a sieve, and the ministry burns with alarm.
ev_customs_leak_opt1_desc: More boats and men; patrol the coast day and night.
ev_customs_leak_res1: Contraband recedes, but the chase costs a fortune—the vault takes another blow.
ev_customs_leak_opt2_desc: Buyers punished with the smugglers; ten households answer for each other.
ev_customs_leak_res2: Wrongful cases multiply; the coastal folk grow bitter, and a storm gathers.
ev_debt_default_desc: The old bonds fall due and {kingdom} cannot pay—the creditors' faces chill faster than the rates.
ev_debt_default_opt1_desc: Delay the repayment under one pretext or another.
ev_debt_default_res1: Creditors reel and pull their money; with the merchant world of every nation, the credit of {kingdom} sinks to freezing—and the undercurrent has not yet stopped.
ev_debt_default_opt2_desc: Pledge the palace treasures and pay every coin.
ev_debt_default_res2: The debt is cleared, the vaults left bare, and resentment quietly brews—this, one fears, is not where it ends.
ev_credit_ice_desc: The credit of {kingdom} has fallen into an ice cellar—each trading house draws its purse as one draws a scythe.
ev_credit_ice_opt1_desc: Put gold up as guarantee to win over the market first.
ev_credit_ice_res1: Handfuls of gold go down—and the iceberg cracks by a hair.
ev_credit_ice_opt2_desc: Edict: the houses must lend as before, or answer for it.
ev_credit_ice_res2: The houses obey in show and dodge in deed; the market's cash freezes all the harder.
ev_merchant_gift_desc: A great merchant waits at the palace gate with thirty thousand in gold—asking but one passage charter from {king}.
ev_merchant_gift_opt1_desc: Take the gold into the purse and issue the charter.
ev_merchant_gift_res1: Gold joins the vault of {kingdom}, and the market speaks only of royal grace.
ev_merchant_gift_opt2_desc: Not a coin taken; the list of gifts returned with all courtesy.
ev_merchant_gift_res2: The merchant sweeps off; the trading world has words of reproach for {kingdom}.
ev_tax_shield_desc: The stricken counties petition together to waive three parts of the levies—the brush of {king} hovers over the vermilion assent.
ev_tax_shield_opt1_desc: The vermilion stroke grants three parts; the country folk draw breath.
ev_tax_shield_res1: The counties revive; the stores of {kingdom} shrink by another notch.
ev_tax_shield_opt2_desc: The state's need is pressing; tell them to return after the autumn.
ev_tax_shield_res2: The folk gather at the offices, and the cry of grievance swells day by day.
ev_relief_auction_desc: The flood recedes and the hungry choke the roads—the rich gentlemen have silver carried in, to cheer on {king}.
ev_relief_auction_opt1_desc: Honorary ranks to the highest bidder; the sum goes straight to relief.
ev_relief_auction_res1: Relief silver lands; the vault of {kingdom} recovers, and the realm approves.
ev_relief_auction_opt2_desc: Young and old alike, relief by every household.
ev_relief_auction_res2: The neighbors spread the tale; every nation praises the benevolence of {kingdom}.
ev_coin_cut_desc: The copper coins of {kingdom} are gnawed thin by scissors, one by one—and the market has begun to refuse them.
ev_coin_cut_opt1_desc: Let the clipped coins run as before; feign not to know.
ev_coin_cut_res1: Bad coin reigns; prices boil and seethe, and complaints rise on all sides.
ev_coin_cut_opt2_desc: Call in the clipped coins and restrike them full.
ev_coin_cut_res2: Fresh coin is struck into circulation; the market settles back into calm.
ev_enterprise_rent_desc: The crafts flourish and the workshop masters fill their stores—a glance turns from the ministry, and it is fixed on the factories of {kingdom}.
ev_enterprise_rent_opt1_desc: Record the yearly gains; take a tenth as rent.
ev_enterprise_rent_res1: The rents come in on time and add luster to the vault of {kingdom}.
ev_enterprise_rent_opt2_desc: In the flush, double it—and every master wails.
ev_enterprise_rent_res2: The masters close their workshops in protest; the clamor reaches the palace gate.
ev_tax_relief_petition_desc: The guilds and the elders petition together: taxes weigh heavy and the people suffer—may {king} remit one part or two.
ev_tax_relief_petition_opt1_desc: Light labor, thin levies; three parts off each year.
ev_tax_relief_petition_res1: The folk sing praise; the nations too admire {kingdom}'s care for its people—if only the vault had not thinned for it.
ev_tax_relief_petition_opt2_desc: The state thirsts for funds; this plea, much as we regret, cannot be granted.
ev_tax_relief_petition_res2: The petitioners kneel long before the palace; the crowd seethes, all injustice.
ev_state_pawnshop_desc: Pawnshops reap fat gains; the ministry petitions a state-owned house—profit to {kingdom}, or profit to the alleys?
ev_state_pawnshop_opt1_desc: State silver as the capital; pledges at a modest, steady rate.
ev_state_pawnshop_res1: The shop opens in season; {kingdom} gains a modest income.
ev_state_pawnshop_opt2_desc: The state will not vie with the people for gain; let the matter drop.
ev_state_pawnshop_res2: The street pawnshops carry on as ever; the state chest stays pinched.
ev_port_duties_desc: Ocean ships crowd the harbor; the ministry proposes higher port dues—the brush of {king} stirs ten thousand miles of sea road.
ev_port_duties_opt1_desc: A tenth of cargo value; the year's income looks handsome.
ev_port_duties_res1: The port dues enter the purse as ordained; the vault of {kingdom} thickens.
ev_port_duties_opt2_desc: Delay the inspections, fine on the side, dock secretly—all by custom.
ev_port_duties_res2: Sea merchants rail on all sides; neighboring ports steal the trade from then on.
ev_fraud_accounting_desc: A whisper denounces the ministry clerks for forging books—two ledgers lie before {king}, one contradicting the other.
ev_fraud_accounting_opt1_desc: Three courts in joint session; turn over twenty years of ledgers.
ev_fraud_accounting_res1: The forged books drag up old cases one after another; every official fears for himself, and turmoil gathers.
ev_fraud_accounting_opt2_desc: Hush the matter; hire accounting clerks for a heavy price to check the books.
ev_fraud_accounting_res2: The books come clean, but the silver of {kingdom} shows the bottom of one more corner.
ev_budget_lean_desc: Income cannot meet outlay; the ministry petitions austerity—wherever the brush of {king} first falls, there the grumbling grows.
ev_budget_lean_opt1_desc: Halt the courier stops, cut the processions, merge the offices.
ev_budget_lean_res1: The yearly outlay falls at a stroke; the chest of {kingdom} slowly brightens.
ev_budget_lean_opt2_desc: Halve the clerks' wages; send the surplus hands home.
ev_budget_lean_res2: The clerks' fury boils; the business of the offices all but stalls.
ev_duke_sword_desc: The duke comes to the feast with his sword; it rings aloud and all the courtiers pale. What shall {king} do?
ev_duke_sword_opt1_desc: Take the sword, strip his guards — a warning to all.
ev_duke_sword_res1: The duke is shamed before all; his retainers mutter; undercurrents stir in the palace.
ev_duke_sword_opt2_desc: Grip the hilt yourself and smile: such merit deserves reward.
ev_duke_sword_res2: The duke kowtows in gratitude; even foreign courts speak of {king}'s magnanimity.
ev_palace_lady_desc: The new concubine turns out to be {king}'s distant kin; all the city buzzes of consort relatives, and the censors are much alarmed.
ev_palace_lady_opt1_desc: Ennoble her by rite and take the worthier kin into office.
ev_palace_lady_res1: The kin are grateful; foreign courts praise {king}'s choice of worth, which weighs merit over blood.
ev_palace_lady_opt2_desc: Blame her for dabbling in rule and send her kin away.
ev_palace_lady_res2: The lady weeps; her kin nurse grudges; the harem trembles with rumor.
ev_eunuch_power_desc: The eunuch chief rules the inner court; even {king}'s edicts pass through his hands, and officials seethe in silence.
ev_eunuch_power_opt1_desc: Bribe him with gold and silk so he keeps his eunuchs in check.
ev_eunuch_power_res1: The eunuchs quiet down and foreign courts approve — but the vaults run thin.
ev_eunuch_power_opt2_desc: Sweep the eunuch faction and judge them by law, no matter the fallout.
ev_eunuch_power_res2: The eunuchs fall, but the net is wide and the palace is uneasy for days.
ev_dowager_veil_desc: The dowager claims {king} is young and rules from behind the veil; her voice outweighs the throne, and the court divides.
ev_dowager_veil_opt1_desc: Allow the dowager to sit in state; power moves behind the veil for now.
ev_dowager_veil_res1: The dowager holds court; edicts issue in two voices... the shadow behind the veil deepens.
ev_dowager_veil_opt2_desc: Lead the courtiers in asking her to return the reins — courtly in form, firm in substance.
ev_dowager_veil_res2: The dowager withdraws; foreign courts hear of {king}'s will to rule in person.
ev_regent_reform_desc: The veiled dowager moves to reform the founding laws; the court seethes. How shall {king} speak?
ev_regent_reform_opt1_desc: Approve the new course: cast out the old, renew the laws.
ev_regent_reform_res1: The reform takes hold; foreign courts take note and call {kingdom} full of vigor.
ev_regent_reform_opt2_desc: The founding laws are not lightly shaken; reject the reform bill.
ev_regent_reform_res2: The reform dies; old ministers preen, but the court nurses mutual grudges.
ev_crown_prince_visit_desc: The crown prince, now of age, asks to tour the foreign courts for {king}; the ministers are split and no verdict comes.
ev_crown_prince_visit_opt1_desc: Send him forth so foreign courts may greet the heir as a prince.
ev_crown_prince_visit_res1: Wherever the prince goes, honors abound; {kingdom}'s foreign ties flourish.
ev_crown_prince_visit_opt2_desc: His studies are unfinished; keep him by the hearth and the books.
ev_crown_prince_visit_res2: The prince studies at court; all is as it was, no wave stirred.
ev_royal_confessor_desc: The royal confessor begs {king} to restore the daily audience rite, saying it will right the order and quell the courtiers; his plea is earnest.
ev_royal_confessor_opt1_desc: Do as he asks: restore the rite and set the order straight.
ev_royal_confessor_res1: The court stands in order; envoys praise {king}'s diligence.
ev_royal_confessor_opt2_desc: Pick an auspicious day instead, without the heavy formalities.
ev_royal_confessor_res2: The rite stays unreformed; the confessor sighs and departs, and memorials grow rare from then on.
ev_palace_oath_desc: A close minister seeks an oath of shared fortune with {king}, asking for a token; the rite-master calls it unheard of.
ev_palace_oath_opt1_desc: Give a jade token and seal the oath of one heart.
ev_palace_oath_res1: The oath is sworn; the minister serves; even foreign courts hold it worthy.
ev_palace_oath_opt2_desc: A private oath upsets the order of lord and minister; refuse it.
ev_palace_oath_res2: The minister is stung with shame; whispers fill the court and loyalty clouds.
ev_hunt_omen: An Ill Omen at the Hunt
ev_hunt_omen_desc: On the autumn hunt {king}'s arrow finds the deer, yet it weeps without end, tears of blood about; the retinue calls it an ill omen.
ev_hunt_omen_opt1_desc: Hunt down those who spread the omen and steady the hearts of all.
ev_hunt_omen_res1: The talk dies, but dread lingers; the hunt ground grows strange.
ev_hunt_omen_opt2_desc: Laugh: heaven's mandate is mine — and continue the hunt.
ev_hunt_omen_res2: All calm a little; the hunt goes on as ever, with a rich catch.
ev_heir_tutor_desc: The heir grows in years; talk of a famed tutor revives, and {king} ponders the wisest choice.
ev_heir_tutor_opt1_desc: Hire a famous scholar as tutor of poetry, books, rites and law.
ev_heir_tutor_res1: The sage enters court; the heir improves; foreign courts praise it with one voice.
ev_heir_tutor_opt2_desc: The royal school has masters; no outside hand is needed.
ev_heir_tutor_res2: The heir keeps to the royal school and its old rules; no wave is stirred.
ev_concubine_audit_desc: A tip says forbidden goods hide in the palace; the rite-master asks {king} to search every wing, and the ladies tremble.
ev_concubine_audit_opt1_desc: Show no favor; search room by room and judge by law.
ev_concubine_audit_res1: Several abuses surface; the ladies are shaken and grumbling spreads through the court.
ev_concubine_audit_opt2_desc: Call the chief attendants and deal gently with them.
ev_concubine_audit_res2: No great offense is found; the harem keeps its peace and the rumor fades.
ev_marriage_plot_desc: A neighbor seeks the princess, yet its minister secretly meets {king} and offers bribes on behalf of spies, plotting from within and without.
ev_marriage_plot_opt1_desc: Give the princess in marriage; the two dynasties become kin.
ev_marriage_plot_res1: The contract sets; foreign courts come to congratulate; {kingdom}'s ties grow long.
ev_marriage_plot_opt2_desc: Privately probe the bribery and decline the suit with courtesy.
ev_marriage_plot_res2: The refusal spreads; the court buzzes and lord and minister eye each other.
ev_royal_bodyguard_desc: A close minister says the bodyguard has slackened and grown old and weak; he begs {king} to fund drill and rotation.
ev_royal_bodyguard_opt1_desc: Vault gold into drill and retire the worn-out men.
ev_royal_bodyguard_res1: The guard stands renewed; no one dares slacken by the throne.
ev_royal_bodyguard_opt2_desc: The vaults are tight; set the drill aside.
ev_royal_bodyguard_res2: The guard stays as it was; the throne is as ever, only the watchfulness slackens.
ev_eunuch_land_desc: The censor impeaches eunuchs for holding hundreds of hidden acres that pay no tax; he begs {king} to judge.
ev_eunuch_land_opt1_desc: Send surveyors, measure the hidden acres, and seize them for the crown.
ev_eunuch_land_res1: The lands are seized, the revenue swells, and the vaults fill.
ev_eunuch_land_opt2_desc: To strike could harm the cup; set the matter silently aside.
ev_eunuch_land_res2: The eunuchs grow prouder; officials seethe but dare not speak.
ev_censor_impeach_desc: The censor impeaches a favorite for graft; the ledgers are proof, and {king}'s court falls dead silent.
ev_censor_impeach_opt1_desc: Order the tribunals to sit and dig to the bottom.
ev_censor_impeach_res1: The favorite falls; the net catches many, and the court rocks without end.
ev_censor_impeach_opt2_desc: Keep the memorial unopened and inquire quietly.
ev_censor_impeach_res2: The memorial stalls; the censor leaves vexed; the matter fades.
ev_court_banquet_desc: {king}'s birthday nears; the rite-master asks a great feast for envoys, but the budget keeper pleads extravagance.
ev_court_banquet_opt1_desc: Hang the lamps, raise the banners and feast every envoy.
ev_court_banquet_res1: The feast ends in joy; foreign courts praise {kingdom}'s gracious hospitality — only the vault grows thin.
ev_court_banquet_opt2_desc: A modest cup within the palace; envoys send their greetings only.
ev_court_banquet_res2: The birthday passes in thrift; the guests disperse; no wave stirs.
ev_astrology_omen_desc: The astrologers see a lucky star enter {kingdom}'s quarter of the sky and ask to proclaim it to the world.
ev_astrology_omen_opt1_desc: Send forth the edict: heaven's favor rests upon the realm, a bright portent.
ev_astrology_omen_res1: The auspice spreads; foreign courts send envoys to congratulate {kingdom}, missions strung along the roads.
ev_astrology_omen_opt2_desc: Heaven's word is not lightly told; command silence.
ev_astrology_omen_res2: The star is kept from tongues; the palace proceeds as always, though the starwatchers look disappointed.
ev_royal_seal_desc: A secret word from the inner court: the royal seal vanished overnight, likely stolen by a servant; {king} burns, and the whole palace hears.
ev_royal_seal_opt1_desc: Bar the gates and search every person; show no mercy.
ev_royal_seal_res1: Days of searching yield nothing; every maid and eunuch fears for himself.
ev_royal_seal_opt2_desc: Strike a new seal for use and quietly seek the old.
ev_royal_seal_res2: The new seal is done; the old stays lost, and the vaults have paid again.
ev_succession_will_desc: An old bamboo case opens to reveal the late king's will; its words run against the current succession talk.
ev_succession_will_opt1_desc: Settle the succession by the will and silence the talk of court and country.
ev_succession_will_res1: The will is read, the name fixed; foreign courts say {king} honors the forebear's wish.
ev_succession_will_opt2_desc: Question the handwriting and revisit it another day.
ev_succession_will_res2: The will's truth becomes a faction war; the court splits like river and water.
ev_old_guard_pension_desc: Ministers who fought beside {king} for decades, now aged, ask to retire with a decent pension.
ev_old_guard_pension_opt1_desc: Grant gold, silk, land and house — a glorious farewell that keeps their dignity.
ev_old_guard_pension_res1: The old men take their leave in tears; the vaults have dimmed, yet their honor is carried far.
ev_old_guard_pension_opt2_desc: Keep them in sinecures at half pay to spare the treasury.
ev_old_guard_pension_res2: The old men seethe, sighing in chorus that {king} is cold to his own; the court glances sidelong.
ev_prince_exile_desc: The prince's secret letters to a border general break open before court and country; {king} burns — how should this brother be judged?
ev_prince_exile_opt1_desc: Strip his rank, exile him to the south wastelands, and bar his return.
ev_prince_exile_res1: The prince heads south; foreign courts whisper of {king} cutting his own flesh and blood.
ev_prince_exile_opt2_desc: Order him behind locked gates to reflect, in reduced circumstance.
ev_prince_exile_res2: The prince's house is watched day and night; every royal kin dreads his own turn.
ev_royal_birth_desc: The queen bears a prince — a clear, bright cry; {king} is overjoyed, courtiers congratulate, and the guards cheer them on.
ev_royal_birth_opt1_desc: Proclaim amnesty, open the stores, and let the realm rejoice.
ev_royal_birth_res1: The realm cheers; foreign courts bring congratulations; {kingdom} stands unmatched in the hour.
ev_royal_birth_opt2_desc: Set aside pomp; tell the ancestors, grant modest rewards, and leave the folk in peace.
ev_royal_birth_res2: The joyful word spreads; the realm congratulates, yet daily life is undisturbed.
ev_heir_duel_desc: The heir and a prince clash in the yard before a packed crowd; the result binds the heir's honor and the people's hearts.
ev_heir_duel_opt1_desc: No one stops it; let the outcome take its own course.
ev_heir_duel_res1: A stroke goes wrong; the heir is hurt; rumor spills through court and country.
ev_heir_duel_opt2_desc: Step into the yard yourself, halt it, and gift both their prizes.
ev_heir_duel_res2: The bout turns safe; foreign courts say {king} teaches his kin well, and the family ties hold.
ev_court_faction_desc: Two court factions trade accusations; memorials snow onto {king}'s desk and rob him of sleep.
ev_court_faction_opt1_desc: Side with neither; watch the storm turn and still it by stillness.
ev_court_faction_res1: The strife rages on; governance nearly grinds to a halt and memorials pile up like hills.
ev_court_faction_opt2_desc: Summon both factions to confront and rule on right and wrong yourself.
ev_court_faction_res2: Right and wrong are settled; the strife eases; foreign courts praise {king}'s firm hand.
ev_eunuch_reform_desc: The eunuch offices swell; some eunuchs beg {king} to purge the rolls for a payment in gold; the court splits.
ev_eunuch_reform_opt1_desc: Let the surplus redeem themselves with gold; keep the able.
ev_eunuch_reform_res1: The rolls are renewed; the ransoms pour in and the vaults fill.
ev_eunuch_reform_opt2_desc: Call it huckstering and refuse outright.
ev_eunuch_reform_res2: The refusal spreads; the eunuch faction closes ranks and the palace bickers behind closed doors.
ev_queen_rescript_desc: The queen pleads for {king} to let her open the granaries for the starving; censors sneer at a consort ruling.
ev_queen_rescript_opt1_desc: Let her open the stores and feed the starving.
ev_queen_rescript_res1: The starving are saved; foreign courts praise {king} and his queen as one, and the word of their kindness crosses every border.
ev_queen_rescript_opt2_desc: Tell her the chamber stays out of rule; no stores.
ev_queen_rescript_res2: The queen sulks; chamber and censors each nurse their grudge.
ev_loyalist_swear_desc: The grand censor seeks audience to swear his loyalty and asks {king} to make him the foremost adviser, so the court will be put in order.
ev_loyalist_swear_opt1_desc: Receive the oath in hall and entrust him with the charge of counsel.
ev_loyalist_swear_res1: The loyal man is put to use; court and country rejoice; foreign courts hold it worthy.
ev_loyalist_swear_opt2_desc: Warm praise, but no seat at the head of the council.
ev_loyalist_swear_res2: The censor bows twice and withdraws; for now no wave stirs, yet his heart is not still.
ev_spy_in_palace_desc: The secret service finds a foreign spy long hidden in the palace, with eyes and hands everywhere.
ev_spy_in_palace_opt1_desc: Feign ignorance, feed him false word; let the line run long.
ev_spy_in_palace_res1: The false word is in his hands; that court grows careless of {kingdom}; the net awaits next year.
ev_spy_in_palace_opt2_desc: Bar the gates, follow the leads, and catch him.
ev_spy_in_palace_res2: Days of sweeping the palace; all tremble, yet the spy seems to have vanished from the earth.
ev_spy_exposure_desc: Time to close the net; the duped spy scrambles to flee, even as his nation's envoy comes asking.
ev_spy_exposure_opt1_desc: Hang his head high as a stern warning and cleanse the chamber.
ev_spy_exposure_res1: The spy dies, but that court burns with rage and the talk here does not settle.
ev_spy_exposure_opt2_desc: Spare his life, send him richly home to keep the peace.
ev_spy_exposure_res2: The spy goes home; that court is shamed, and foreign courts praise {kingdom}'s gracious might.
ev_crown_jewels_desc: Royal jewels turn up in a pawnshop; the trail points to a kinsman of {king}'s inner court.
ev_crown_jewels_opt1_desc: Redeem the treasure quickly and hush the matter.
ev_crown_jewels_res1: The jewels return, yet the vault stands far emptier and will not recover this year.
ev_crown_jewels_opt2_desc: Arrest all hands involved and question them hard.
ev_crown_jewels_res2: Old palace offenses surface in a string; every noble kin fears for himself.
ev_hunting_pact_desc: A neighbor invites {king} to hunt the border hills together, hoping to settle trade and frontier terms; the offer seems sincere.
ev_hunting_pact_opt1_desc: Ride out with your guards; talk terms after the chase.
ev_hunting_pact_res1: The hunt is joyfully done, the treaty signed, and neighborly bonds bind tighter.
ev_hunting_pact_opt2_desc: Plead the season and send word of refusal.
ev_hunting_pact_res2: The neighbor does not raise it again; the hunt is off, and the frontier stays as it was.
ev_fortune_teller_desc: A fortune teller begs audience and reads {king}'s face: next year comes a great drought; avert it early or the granaries will stand empty.
ev_fortune_teller_opt1_desc: Pay him well and raise an altar to pray for rain, as he says.
ev_fortune_teller_res1: The altar rises; foreign courts hear how {king} reveres heaven and pities his people.
ev_fortune_teller_opt2_desc: Call it sorcery-talk and cast him from the gates.
ev_fortune_teller_res2: The fortune teller insists on the prophecy; the rumor swells and hearts waver.
ev_princess_guard_desc: The princess's wedding nears; the rite-master asks {king} to enlarge her guard for the grand procession, and the treasury keeper objects.
ev_princess_guard_opt1_desc: Fund extra chariots and guards to give the procession splendor.
ev_princess_guard_res1: The guard stands in order; the princess leaves in proper splendor, and folk along the road admire.
ev_princess_guard_opt2_desc: Follow the old rule, enlarge nothing, and spare the vaults.
ev_princess_guard_res2: The guard stays as it was; the rites complete, all return, and nothing is amiss.
