ev_noble_trial_desc: A hereditary earl seized farmland and the peasants cry out; the case file lies before {king}, and kinsmen beg for mercy.
ev_noble_trial_opt1_desc: Punish the seizure by law and confiscate the lands.
ev_noble_trial_res1: The earl falls; noble kin glare sidelong; slander rises on all sides.
ev_noble_trial_opt2_desc: Order the fields returned and a fine paid; lend the punishment less weight.
ev_noble_trial_res2: The fields return; foreign courts say {king} tempers justice with mercy.
ev_jester_reign_desc: The jester attends {king} daily, gossip and jokes in one breath; the inner circle is much displeased.
ev_jester_reign_opt1_desc: He is amusing; let him be, but keep him from rule.
ev_jester_reign_res1: The jester comes and goes through the six courts unhindered; court and land glare sidelong.
ev_jester_reign_opt2_desc: Limit his comings and goings, keep reward and rebuke in hand, and tidy the court rules.
ev_jester_reign_res2: The jester reins in; the court jokes on, and no wave stirs.
ev_ancestral_rites_desc: The ancestral rite nears; the rite-master asks for the three beasts and nine sauces at no small cost, while the budget keeper fights for thrift.
ev_ancestral_rites_opt1_desc: Prepare by the rite; three days of solemn offering to requite the ancestors.
ev_ancestral_rites_res1: Incense curls over the ancestral hall; foreign courts say {king} keeps his root.
ev_ancestral_rites_opt2_desc: Trim the offerings; a pure-hearted rite is enough.
ev_ancestral_rites_res2: The modest rite holds; all stays calm, only the rite-master looks displeased.
ev_royal_soothsayer_desc: The soothsayer warns of great change in the autumn that only a general amnesty can avert; he begs {king} to decide and heed the folk.
ev_royal_soothsayer_opt1_desc: Issue the amnesty as he bids, praying the ill is warded off.
ev_royal_soothsayer_res1: The amnesty falls; the people are grateful; foreign courts carry news of {king}'s mercy.
ev_royal_soothsayer_opt2_desc: Call it delusion of the people and strip his office.
ev_royal_soothsayer_res2: The soothsayer is cast out; talk among the folk blazes like spreading sparks.
ev_heir_foreign_desc: A bloodline of the late king, raised in foreign lands, returns home and begs {king} to restore his name; the ministers divide.
ev_heir_foreign_opt1_desc: Verify his blood, bring him to the ancestral hall, and tell the late king.
ev_heir_foreign_res1: The prince returns to the line; foreign courts praise {kingdom}'s regard for kin and blood.
ev_heir_foreign_opt2_desc: Doubt his provenance, politely refuse, and steady the court.
ev_heir_foreign_res2: The newcomer leaves in a huff; voices of regret and of jeering rise together in court.
ev_king_brew_desc: The wine house finishes a hundred jars of royal brew; the rite-master asks to gift them to envoys, winning {king} friends abroad.
ev_king_brew_opt1_desc: Choose the hundred jars and send them to the envoys.
ev_king_brew_res1: Where the brew arrives, foreign courts rejoice, only the wine vault and the gold vault shrink alike.
ev_king_brew_opt2_desc: Keep it for the inner court; not a coin spent.
ev_king_brew_res2: The royal brew rests in the cellar; nothing stirs, only the unsealing next year.
ev_heir_adoption_desc: The throne lacks an heir; a youth of the royal line is nominated, though his father once stood against {king}.
ev_heir_adoption_opt1_desc: Lay the old grudge aside, make him heir, and entrust the realm's root to him.
ev_heir_adoption_res1: The heir enters the palace, the old grudge dissolves; foreign courts praise {king} for placing the realm first.
ev_heir_adoption_opt2_desc: Fear the consequences; pick a collateral branch instead.
ev_heir_adoption_res2: The youth leaves with rancor; the royal kin debate it endlessly.
ev_sword_guild_desc: A rivalry of arms lies before {king}: the sword guild asks to monopolize royal weapons, and the court is split.
ev_sword_guild_opt1_desc: Let the guild rule the royal forge; prices and wages are all negotiable.
ev_sword_guild_res1: The guild is grateful; blades are fine, and realms praise the steel of {kingdom}.
ev_sword_guild_opt2_desc: Revoke the privilege; the guild raises an outcry, and trouble threatens.
ev_sword_guild_res2: The guild fumes, the smiths strike, and the soldiers' hearts waver.
ev_armor_works_desc: The arms rivalry rises again: the armor works ask to sell wares openly to sustain themselves — {king} must rule.
ev_armor_works_opt1_desc: Allow them to sell armor; both wages and war funds find their footing.
ev_armor_works_res1: Trade flows; the treasury of {kingdom} swells, and armor sells across the realms.
ev_armor_works_opt2_desc: Ban the trade; the works run short, and smiths drift away.
ev_armor_works_res2: Craftsmen scatter, armor runs thin, and the army's grumbling grows.
ev_archer_lodge_desc: Amid the arms rivalry the Archer Lodge stands apart, asking {king} to keep its own rules and recruit freely.
ev_archer_lodge_opt1_desc: Let it frame its own rules; the lodge is grateful and its archery sharpens.
ev_archer_lodge_res1: The lodge's fame rings far; realms turn well-disposed toward {kingdom}.
ev_archer_lodge_opt2_desc: File the request away; the lodge stays quiet and keeps to itself.
ev_archer_lodge_res2: The lodge stays still as before — no storm comes, and no glory either.
ev_wage_arrears_desc: The war grinds on; {kingdom}'s pay is three months late — murmur rises in the camp, and {king} must decide fast.
ev_wage_arrears_opt1_desc: Empty the treasury to pay three months of wages; the men rejoice while the purse aches.
ev_wage_arrears_res1: Wages in hand, the army rests a while — whether the root is pulled, the days will tell.
ev_wage_arrears_opt2_desc: Plead the hard war and hold the pay; the men nurse grudges and the shouting swells.
ev_wage_arrears_res2: Grumbling runs high; at night the wind of mutiny stirs — the aftermath lies unwritten.
ev_mutiny_quell_desc: The arrears crack at last: a battalion mutinies at the camp gate. {king} must judge — mercy or iron.
ev_mutiny_quell_opt1_desc: Behead the ringleaders and punish the rest; the ranks quail while grudges re-root.
ev_mutiny_quell_res1: The mutiny dies down, yet fierce currents run beneath the iron — disorder is not gone.
ev_mutiny_quell_opt2_desc: Promise the arrears and amnesty; the men lay down arms, and the cost is high.
ev_mutiny_quell_res2: Anger eases and blades return to sheaths; the treasury takes a deep deficit.
ev_levy_call_desc: The front runs short and men must be raised at once: {king} may conscript the realm or hire mercenaries.
ev_levy_call_opt1_desc: Draft the peasantry; resentment rises and the fields lie fallow.
ev_levy_call_res1: The ranks are filled, but villages seethe and resentment ripens into disorder.
ev_levy_call_opt2_desc: Pay gold for mercenaries; soldiers come in plenty and the treasury thins.
ev_levy_call_res2: The recruits stand and the host revives; the treasury bears a heavy cost.
ev_border_watch_desc: The north reports alarms; the border posts lie neglected. {king} may rebuild the beacons — at no small cost.
ev_border_watch_opt1_desc: Spend on forts and watch-posts; beacons link eye to eye and border ills subside.
ev_border_watch_res1: The line stands renewed, scouts reach far; the gold has turned into stone.
ev_border_watch_opt2_desc: Change nothing; the garrisons stand as before and fate takes its course.
ev_border_watch_res2: The border holds as ever — no new perils, and no new strength either.
ev_veteran_pension_desc: Discharged veterans gather at the gate and demand their settlement. {king}'s grace or refusal will quell or stir the army.
ev_veteran_pension_opt1_desc: Grant silver and gratitude; the veterans weep while the inner treasury stands empty.
ev_veteran_pension_res1: Each veteran finds his place and goes home praising the righteousness of {kingdom}.
ev_veteran_pension_opt2_desc: Bid them fend for themselves; the veterans fume and the camps buzz aloud.
ev_veteran_pension_res2: The veterans nurse their wrath through the alleys, and the murmur carries into every camp.
ev_marching_training_desc: Long peace has dulled the ranks. {king} may renew the drill code and hold a great review — at no small expense.
ev_marching_training_opt1_desc: Pay the men and reopen the drills; the old law is restated and the host shines anew.
ev_marching_training_res1: Step and order run as one; a few copper coins have bought an army of iron.
ev_marching_training_opt2_desc: Skip the drill; the men grow scattered and used to ease.
ev_marching_training_res2: No drill, no progress; laziness creeps in and the host's bearing sags day by day.
ev_general_rivalry_desc: Two veteran generals fight for honor before the tent, each with his own hill. Favoring one may leave a canker in the host.
ev_general_rivalry_opt1_desc: Praise one general by edict and charge him with the host — the other swallows gall.
ev_general_rivalry_res1: Factions harden and feuds run on; military orders now speak with two tongues.
ev_general_rivalry_opt2_desc: Honor both and bid them share the burdens of the hour.
ev_general_rivalry_res2: Both sheathe their edges; realms hear that generals and ministers of {kingdom} stand in harmony.
ev_siege_test_desc: New rams and towers stand ready; {king} would put their edge to the test in a live drill — no light expense.
ev_siege_test_opt1_desc: Raise a mock wall and set elite troops to test the engines; a sound method may follow.
ev_siege_test_res1: The worth of every engine is known and siegecraft sharpens; gold and silk burn with it.
ev_siege_test_opt2_desc: Merely parade the machines, never trying them beneath the walls.
ev_siege_test_res2: The engines gather dust, siegecraft stands still, and the affair is wasted.
ev_scout_failure_desc: A scout misreports; a host misses its chance at victory and loses hundreds. {king} must weigh the blame.
ev_scout_failure_opt1_desc: Execute the scout-chief to restore discipline; the ranks quail, yet grudges are born.
ev_scout_failure_res1: Discipline recovers, but whispers of injustice dampen the hearts of the host.
ev_scout_failure_opt2_desc: Flog the leader and spare his life; the host falls into guarded silence.
ev_scout_failure_res2: The scout lives and hearts ease a little, yet the ache of the lost chance endures.
ev_navy_draft_desc: The coast is restless; the fleet must recruit sailors and shipwrights. {king} may hire them richly or press them.
ev_navy_draft_opt1_desc: Pay heavily for seasoned sailors; the cost of craft and recruiting is no trifle.
ev_navy_draft_res1: The fleet stands, masts like a forest; the treasury begins to show its straits.
ev_navy_draft_opt2_desc: Enroll every coastal household into the navy rolls; the outcry fills the roads.
ev_navy_draft_res2: Fishing villages decay, the households nurse grudges, and the recruits drill sullenly.
ev_camp_disease_desc: Plague stalks the host and men fall daily. The physicians beg medicine of {king} — it costs a thousand in gold.
ev_camp_disease_opt1_desc: Pay dear for herbs and open an apothecary to brew and tend the sick.
ev_camp_disease_res1: The pestilence recedes and the host revives; the remedy bill is a heavy charge.
ev_camp_disease_opt2_desc: Burn only mugwort and let men mend themselves; the smell of the dead is everywhere.
ev_camp_disease_res2: The plague spreads, ranks dwindle, and fighting strength takes a heavy blow.
ev_weapon_bribe_desc: A quartermaster colludes with a rogue trader and passes off shoddy steel. {king} holds the proof and must judge it.
ev_weapon_bribe_opt1_desc: Arrest the quartermaster and recover the stolen goods; the host stands in awe.
ev_weapon_bribe_res1: The graft is swept clean, yet many are entangled, and denunciations flare on every side.
ev_weapon_bribe_opt2_desc: Rebuke lightly and cover it over; the rogue trader laughs as before.
ev_weapon_bribe_res2: Shoddy gear still enters the stores; the army grows cold inside and resentment piles up.
ev_royal_guard_move_desc: The royal guard has long sat about the capital, sunk in ease. {king} would move them out and drill them hard.
ev_royal_guard_move_opt1_desc: Fund an outpost beyond the walls, restate the rules, and weary the men with drill.
ev_royal_guard_move_res1: The guard regains sinew and stands firmer; the outlay is considerable.
ev_royal_guard_move_opt2_desc: Pity their toil and keep them in the city; no move is made.
ev_royal_guard_move_res2: The guard keeps its post as ever — no new incidents, and no new edge either.
ev_desertion_desc: War clouds press on the city; in one night hundreds of the rolls slip away together. {king} must stop the flight.
ev_desertion_opt1_desc: Flog the captured as a warning and implicate their neighbors; the flight pauses a while.
ev_desertion_res1: The runaways are seized, yet village fury boils beneath the rod.
ev_desertion_opt2_desc: Promise return without punishment and wages for their homes; it costs silver by the thousand.
ev_desertion_res2: Half the runaways return; the army steadies a little, and gold and silk drain away with them.
ev_war_plunder_share_desc: The enemy city falls; the baggage is mountainous. {king} may share it among the host, or gather it all into the treasury.
ev_war_plunder_share_opt1_desc: Divide the whole of the spoils, from sergeants to the common soldier; every man is rewarded.
ev_war_plunder_share_res1: The host roars; realms praise {kingdom} for cherishing its soldiers, and hearts stand firm.
ev_war_plunder_share_opt2_desc: Haul the baggage into the treasury; the men walk off empty-handed and aggrieved.
ev_war_plunder_share_res2: The treasury grows rich, but resentment rises through the host and mutiny nearly breaks.
ev_general_young_desc: A stripling commander keeps winning wonders; the generals are startled. {king} would break precedent and raise him high.
ev_general_young_opt1_desc: Promote him above the roster to spur the rest; the old generals look askance.
ev_general_young_res1: He takes the seal; realms praise merit alone in {kingdom}, and the young in arms are roused.
ev_general_young_opt2_desc: Advance him by the ladder of seniority alone; the stripling accepts in silence.
ev_general_young_res2: The veterans nod, the youth is downcast, and the host settles into stillness.
ev_fort_novelty_desc: A cunning craftsman offers a drawing of a novel star-fort. {king} would raise one city to test it — the works will be enormous.
ev_fort_novelty_opt1_desc: Spend gold, break the ground, and raise the fort by the new method; it takes time and toil.
ev_fort_novelty_res1: The fort stands imposing, fair for both attack and defense; the works are heavy indeed.
ev_fort_novelty_opt2_desc: Praise the drawing, then store it away; no earth is stirred.
ev_fort_novelty_res2: The new drawing sleeps in the archive; the old walls stand — neither harmed nor helped.
ev_outpost_security_desc: The outpost beyond the border stands alone; its supply road is often cut. {king} would add men and walls — no mean expense.
ev_outpost_security_opt1_desc: Add sentries and mend the plank road; the outpost rests easy, and the spending is heavy.
ev_outpost_security_res1: The watch runs clear and no beacon burns; gold and silk have gone into stone.
ev_outpost_security_opt2_desc: The outpost stays harried by enemies; peril flashes on every side.
ev_outpost_security_res2: The outpost hangs alone with alarms from time to time; luckily, no great loss as yet.
ev_wounded_care_desc: After every battle the wounded fill the roads; healers and medicine run short. Will {king} spend to save them?
ev_wounded_care_opt1_desc: Found a hospital and buy medicines in quantity to save their lives.
ev_wounded_care_res1: Many of the wounded recover; the host is moved — and the inner treasury grows lighter.
ev_wounded_care_opt2_desc: Bid the healers tend the officers first; common wounded mostly pine away.
ev_wounded_care_res2: The wounded die off; the camps grow cold and voices of complaint rise.
ev_hero_statue_desc: A fallen general served the realm; names on stone are not enough. {king} would cast him in bronze to honor him.
ev_hero_statue_opt1_desc: Gather copper for a statue to stand on the high road; it drains silver by the thousand.
ev_hero_statue_res1: The bronze stands tall and the host stirs to valor; the treasury is shorter by a length.
ev_hero_statue_opt2_desc: Cut a stela recording his deeds; the work is simple and the cost light.
ev_hero_statue_res2: The people retell his loyalty; realms praise {kingdom} for honoring virtue with measure.
ev_land_grant_soldier_desc: Soldiers of a hundred battles leave the ranks with nowhere to go. {king} would grant them fields and rank to ease their age.
ev_land_grant_soldier_opt1_desc: Award fields by merit and titles besides; the outlay is great but the grace is deep.
ev_land_grant_soldier_res1: The men take up the plough and praise the grace of {kingdom}; farming and arms both flourish.
ev_land_grant_soldier_opt2_desc: Grant coin and silk in place of fields, in measured shares, with due difference for the most meritorious.
ev_land_grant_soldier_res2: Veterans go home with gold; realms praise {kingdom} for a generous memory of its old soldiers.
ev_militia_rise_desc: Village levies rout bandits again and again; their fame grows and they are all but an army. {king} may uphold or suppress them.
ev_militia_rise_opt1_desc: Give their chief a title and enter them in the rolls to serve the royal host.
ev_militia_rise_res1: The levies are roused, bandits hold their breath, and realms commend the martial might of {kingdom}.
ev_militia_rise_opt2_desc: Take their arms and scatter their ranks; the levies nurse the grudge across the fields.
ev_militia_rise_res2: Smarting from the shame of disarmament, they gather in the hills by night — disorder lurks unseen.
ev_spy_report_desc: A spy risks death to bring the enemy's defense map; its true worth is hard to tell. Should {king} reward and use it?
ev_spy_report_opt1_desc: Reward the feat richly and bid a chosen general deploy by the map.
ev_spy_report_res1: The spies give their lives; the enemy lies bare, and realms see that {kingdom} knows how to use its agents.
ev_spy_report_opt2_desc: Give a small reward, leave the map on the desk, and let events speak.
ev_spy_report_res2: The spy lies low and guards himself; reports thin out and the enemy fades into fog.
ev_ambush_warning_desc: An old scout sees glints of armor amid the woods and suspects an ambush along both flanks of the road. {king} must settle the march.
ev_ambush_warning_opt1_desc: Trust his word; wheel the whole host off the road and march on guard.
ev_ambush_warning_res1: An ambush indeed waits on the old road; the host is unhurt, and realms praise {kingdom} for heeding counsel.
ev_ambush_warning_opt2_desc: Mock his fears and march the old road as usual.
ev_ambush_warning_res2: The ambush never stirs; a false alarm — and yet how near the danger came.
ev_army_reduction_desc: All is quiet and idle troops eat the budget. {king} debates cutting the host to ease the chest — the resettlement must be fixed first.
ev_army_reduction_opt1_desc: Retire the surplus with passage-money to the plough; the ranks shrink and the chest breathes.
ev_army_reduction_res1: With the surplus gone the treasury slowly fills, and funds for arms are gathered again.
ev_army_reduction_opt2_desc: Strike the numbers at once with no settlement; the cast-off soldiers crowd the roads, boiling with resentment.
ev_army_reduction_res2: The cast-offs mass at the capital gates, curses rising on every side; disorder is about to sprout.
ev_war_trophy_desc: The host takes a city; gold, silver, and the surrender roll pile like mountains. {king} orders the spoils reckoned into the treasury.
ev_war_trophy_opt1_desc: Bring wagon-loads of spoils into the treasury and reward the meritorious in turn.
ev_war_trophy_res1: The treasury swells; {kingdom} marches with a prouder air, and realms both praise and fear it.
ev_war_trophy_opt2_desc: Divide the merit with the generals; each takes his due and their faces kindle.
ev_war_trophy_res2: The officers and men are roused; the name of {kingdom} flies abroad and the host grows bolder.
ev_general_madness_desc: A famed captain suddenly runs mad and cuts down clerks with his sword in the tent. The host is aghast; {king} must deal with it.
ev_general_madness_opt1_desc: Take his seal and sword and fetter him; the host is shaken and begins to doubt.
ev_general_madness_res1: The madman sits in gaol and military law is upheld; yet his old comrades grieve and friction builds unseen.
ev_general_madness_opt2_desc: Absolve him and bid him heal at his mansion; court and camp look askance.
ev_general_madness_res2: The madman lives and discipline slackens; officers whisper and the clouds of doubt will not lift.
ev_barracks_brawl_desc: Men of two battalions fall to blows over wine and honor at the camp gate; more than a hundred are hurt. {king} must close the rift.
ev_barracks_brawl_opt1_desc: Put the ringleaders in the cangue at the camp gate; punish the heads and calm the rest.
ev_barracks_brawl_res1: The brawl sleeps, yet the old grudges of the two battalions remain and private fights break out.
ev_barracks_brawl_opt2_desc: Call both commanders to drink together and make them lay down the quarrel.
ev_barracks_brawl_res2: After the wine they bow to each other and the anger softens — yet tongues soon clash again.
ev_supply_shortfall_desc: The host has besieged the city a month; the enemy severs the grain road and the stores empty day by day. {king} must plan resupply.
ev_supply_shortfall_opt1_desc: Draw from the inner treasury to buy grain from every quarter and haul it to the host; prices soar, the toil bites.
ev_supply_shortfall_res1: Provisions flow again and hearts ease a little, while the treasury begins to show its bottom.
ev_supply_shortfall_opt2_desc: Send the host sweeping the countryside for grain; the homesteads stand empty.
ev_supply_shortfall_res2: Village fury rises on all sides, disorder stirs, and even in the host there is fear of a mutinous break.
ev_battlefield_courage_desc: Amid the grinding battle a single soldier seizes the enemy banner with his halberd; the host's spirits leap as one.
ev_battlefield_courage_opt1_desc: Spread the deed through the host and grant rewards at every rank without stint.
ev_battlefield_courage_res1: The hero's name flies through every camp; realms vie to retell the valor of {kingdom}'s soldiers.
ev_battlefield_courage_opt2_desc: The record is thin and the reward late; the brave man grieves and his men blush with him.
ev_battlefield_courage_res2: His merit wins no heed and morale sags, though the order of the host suffers no great harm.
ev_victory_parade_desc: The host returns in triumph to the court; {king} would hold a rite of presented captives and feast all three armies — a handsome outlay.
ev_victory_parade_opt1_desc: Spend from the chest to feast the host, enfeoff the battle merits, and present the captives at the shrine.
ev_victory_parade_res1: On the day the rites close, envoys from every realm congratulate the martial might of {kingdom}; gold and silk flow like water.
ev_victory_parade_opt2_desc: Give them meat and wine only, without the great rite, sparing the heavy cost.
ev_victory_parade_res2: The soldiers feast well and troop back by company — no resounding fame, and no disorder either.
ev_troop_resupply_desc: At the front more than half the gear is broken and arrows run out. {king} may send supplies in haste, or let them shift for themselves.
ev_troop_resupply_opt1_desc: Buy bows, arrows, and armor, and race them to the front by night and day.
ev_troop_resupply_res1: Gear is made whole and the host revives; the outlay is considerable.
ev_troop_resupply_opt2_desc: Bid the front seize what it needs from enemy lands — but taking from the people stirs their wrath.
ev_troop_resupply_res2: The soldiers plunder the countryside; the outcry fills the roads and discipline falls.
ev_general_protector_desc: An old general of long-standing renown petitions to take command of the whole war policy and tighten the host. {king} may trust him fully or hold him in doubt.
ev_general_protector_opt1_desc: Name him protector of all arms, holding the whole war government; the host falls into reverence.
ev_general_protector_res1: Orders run strict and armor stands ready; realms now vie to renew their friendship with {kingdom}.
ev_general_protector_opt2_desc: Fearing his glory, take away his command; the old general sweeps off his sleeves and leaves.
ev_general_protector_res2: The old general leaves the realm in wrath; his followers are in an uproar and disaffection creeps through the host.
ev_border_feast_desc: At year's end the border troops are weary; the warden begs leave to feast them and invite the neighbor envoys to witness. Should {king} allow it?
ev_border_feast_opt1_desc: Spend from the chest: a rich feast for the garrison, with the neighbor envoys invited.
ev_border_feast_res1: The soldiers clap in joy and the envoys smile with them; the border beacons of {kingdom} rest quiet.
ev_border_feast_opt2_desc: Thank the warden and decline the feast; the garrison keeps the old routine.
ev_border_feast_res2: The chest saves and the men bear no grudge; only the neighborly bond has cooled a little.
ev_archery_club_desc: Nobles' sons vie in archery and found a club outside the walls. {king} would grace it with a plaque and name of his own hand.
ev_archery_club_opt1_desc: Inscribe the name yourself and bestow bows and gear to reward them.
ev_archery_club_res1: The youths are stirred and archery flourishes; realms call {kingdom} courteous and martial at once.
ev_archery_club_opt2_desc: Give no title; let the club keep to its own gatherings.
ev_archery_club_res2: The club shoots on as always — no royal favor, no turbulence.
ev_watchtower_signal_desc: The border beacon towers have long stood unkept and the fire-signals often fail to reach. {king} would spend to restore them all.
ev_watchtower_signal_opt1_desc: Spend on mending every tower and hire careful keepers to watch them.
ev_watchtower_signal_res1: Beacons watch each other across the line and alarms carry at once; gold and silk drain with the works.
ev_watchtower_signal_opt2_desc: Only bid the patrol to mend two or three in passing; the rest stand as before.
ev_watchtower_signal_res2: Alarms still lag, luckily with no harm — yet each day the beacon network decays.
ev_army_fund_embezzle_desc: Of the wages bound for the front, a transport official swallowed three parts; the matter is revealed. {king} must hand down a judgment.
ev_army_fund_embezzle_opt1_desc: Arrest the officer, confiscate the purloined silver, and tighten the rules.
ev_army_fund_embezzle_res1: The thief answers to the law, yet every transport office quakes for itself and blockages rise on all sides.
ev_army_fund_embezzle_opt2_desc: Refill the swallowed wages from the treasury; each camp is set at ease.
ev_army_fund_embezzle_res2: Wages are made whole and hearts ease a little, while the treasury loses a further sum.
ev_shooting_star_desc: At midnight a star falls from heaven, painting the ground with light; {king} summons the stargazers, and the court is uneasy.
ev_shooting_star_opt1_desc: Send envoys to find the stone and share it with the realms.
ev_shooting_star_res1: The stone is shared; kings approve, and the name of {kingdom} spreads abroad.
ev_shooting_star_opt2_desc: Call the omen idle talk and silence the gossip.
ev_shooting_star_res2: The people suspect {king} hides misfortune; rumor surges, and {kingdom} grows restless.
ev_solar_eclipse_desc: Day darkens and stars show at noon; {king} beats drums to rescue the sun while the people cry to heaven.
ev_solar_eclipse_opt1_desc: Behead the court astronomers to stop the talk, calm the people.
ev_solar_eclipse_res1: The astronomers die wronged; the people dread the omen, and gloom clings to {kingdom}.
ev_solar_eclipse_opt2_desc: Share plain food with the folk and ease their burdens.
ev_solar_eclipse_res2: The sun returns and the sky clears; the portent passes and hearts settle.
ev_blood_moon_desc: The full moon bleeds crimson and dogs howl; {king} watches the sky while soldiers and folk kneel to the moon.
ev_blood_moon_opt1_desc: Decree a night ban and scatter the moon-worshippers.
ev_blood_moon_res1: The rush causes trampling; grief and murmurs spread through {kingdom}, hearts waver.
ev_blood_moon_opt2_desc: Issue a clear decree and send envoys to comfort the neighbors.
ev_blood_moon_res2: The realms reply with gifts and courtesies; the fame of {kingdom} grows.
ev_quake_aftershock_desc: The first quake barely settled when the earth heaves and walls crack anew; {king} pales: the veins of the land are restless.
ev_quake_aftershock_opt1_desc: Open the granaries and spend gold to repair the walls.
ev_quake_aftershock_res1: Gold flows like water and the walls rise again, yet the deep rumble never fades: a worse harm lies in wait.
ev_quake_aftershock_opt2_desc: Leave the refugees, do not shore the palace.
ev_quake_aftershock_res2: The jolts tear harder, refugees stream away, and {kingdom} scatters beyond recall.
ev_quake_rebuild_desc: Ruin lies everywhere after the quake; {king} decrees a rebuilding of temples and homes, at a cost beyond measure.
ev_quake_rebuild_opt1_desc: Empty the treasury and hire the people for work-relief.
ev_quake_rebuild_res1: The city rises fresh and grand, but the coffers of {kingdom} stand bare.
ev_quake_rebuild_opt2_desc: Mend roughly and save the rest for other needs.
ev_quake_rebuild_res2: The homes stay shoddy; the people call {king}'s doings a child's game, and anger rises.
ev_hailstorm_desc: Hail the size of fists falls from noon to dusk; {king} sees the fields leveled and knows the harvest is lost.
ev_hailstorm_opt1_desc: Buy new seed and bid the farmers replant in haste.
ev_hailstorm_res1: The late sowing eases the damage, though the revenue of {kingdom} dips.
ev_hailstorm_opt2_desc: Let the folk glean and raise no great works.
ev_hailstorm_res2: The people manage alone, the matter fades, and the stores of {kingdom} stand intact.
ev_frostbite_spring_desc: Frost falls in the third month and the young shoots wither; a village elder tells {king}: this cold is unseen in decades.
ev_frostbite_spring_opt1_desc: Trade reserve grain for seed and sow one season more.
ev_frostbite_spring_res1: New shoots rise and hearts settle; the stores of {kingdom} thin a little.
ev_frostbite_spring_opt2_desc: Say the farms are heaven's to tend; spare the silver.
ev_frostbite_spring_res2: Farmers find no aid, march on the court for answers, and {kingdom} stirs with unrest.
ev_heat_wave_desc: A rainless blaze cracks the ground; on his rounds {king} sees workers struck down by the heat in droves.
ev_heat_wave_opt1_desc: Hand out stored ice, medicine, and gruel along the roads.
ev_heat_wave_res1: Fewer sicken and hearts lean back to the crown; the treasury of {kingdom} spends.
ev_heat_wave_opt2_desc: The court removes to cool hills, indifferent to the people's pain.
ev_heat_wave_res2: Anger spreads and more point at {king}; {kingdom} grows loud with clamor.
ev_typhoon_wind_desc: The typhoon sweeps from the sea, uprooting trees and tearing roofs; from the tower {king} sees half the town flat.
ev_typhoon_wind_opt1_desc: Pay relief to stricken homes and clear the flooded lanes.
ev_typhoon_wind_res1: The town recovers and the homeless find shelter, at a heavy drain on the silver of {kingdom}.
ev_typhoon_wind_opt2_desc: Bar the palace first and leave all relief undone.
ev_typhoon_wind_res2: With no help in sight the victims turn to banditry; alarms of raiders echo through {kingdom}.
ev_sandstorm_desc: Yellow dust hides the sky for three days; {king} cannot see the sun through shuttered glass, and the storm crosses the border — neighbors mourn too.
ev_sandstorm_opt1_desc: Call it heaven's doing and offer the neighbors no courtesy.
ev_sandstorm_res1: Resentful realms cut trade with {kingdom}, and the merchant roads fall silent.
ev_sandstorm_opt2_desc: Bid the folk seal doors and windows and wait out the wind.
ev_sandstorm_res2: The dust at last settles; after the sweeping, farms and homes are as before.
ev_mudslide_desc: After days of rain the mountainside slides; {king} hears that a hamlet is buried and musters men to rescue.
ev_mudslide_opt1_desc: Hire diggers with silver and comfort the wounded and the bereaved.
ev_mudslide_res1: The road opens in days; the dead are buried, the living fed, and the silver of {kingdom} thins.
ev_mudslide_opt2_desc: Fear the victims beg for alms; keep the troops idle.
ev_mudslide_res2: The mire hardens, hungry crowds besiege the city, and the stores of {kingdom} stand in danger.
ev_avalanche_desc: The snow peak cracks with a boom like thunder; {king} hears a caravan was buried in the pass and stands long in grief.
ev_avalanche_opt1_desc: Hire diggers to break the snow and sweep the whole pass.
ev_avalanche_res1: A dozen saved and the road rebuilt; {kingdom} spends no small treasure.
ev_avalanche_opt2_desc: Post notices to halt all travelers and take the detour.
ev_avalanche_res2: The pass stays shut; caravans detour, and {kingdom} loses nothing.
ev_lightning_storm_desc: On a stormy night the sky-fire strikes thrice; {king} hears the granary and stores are alight and rushes to fight the blaze.
ev_lightning_storm_opt1_desc: Oversee the dousing and give silver to the burned-out.
ev_lightning_storm_res1: The fire is quenched and only half the grain is lost; the silver of {kingdom} dips slightly.
ev_lightning_storm_opt2_desc: Sift the fire's cause among shamans and hurl them into jail.
ev_lightning_storm_res2: Shamans suffer and the people fear the net; grievance and terror mingle in {kingdom}.
ev_drought_wells_desc: Scorched earth stretches far and every well is dry; {king} prays in the open while the people line the roads begging for water.
ev_drought_wells_opt1_desc: Hire workers to sink deep wells and lead distant water.
ev_drought_wells_res1: New wells flow and hearts are steadied; the wealth of {kingdom} all but empties.
ev_drought_wells_opt2_desc: Squeeze a levy from the rich and put the poor to corvee.
ev_drought_wells_res2: The rich resent, the poor suffer, and before the drought lifts {kingdom} seethes.
ev_river_channel_desc: The river bursts east and swings south; {king} calls the engineers and sees good fields drowned in the muddy rush.
ev_river_channel_opt1_desc: Raise new dikes to steer the flow and till the flats.
ev_river_channel_res1: The water returns to its bed and new fields open, at a cost beyond counting for {kingdom}.
ev_river_channel_opt2_desc: Yield the old fields to the marsh and move the folk to the south bank.
ev_river_channel_res2: The people settle and the river runs calm; not a coin leaves the treasury of {kingdom}.
ev_locust_larvae_desc: Hoppers teem beyond counting and will not flee from men; an elder tells {king}: their fathers already brought locusts.
ev_locust_larvae_opt1_desc: Buy captured hoppers by the measure, paying silver; the folk flock in.
ev_locust_larvae_res1: The hoppers die out, though burning the corpses follows; {kingdom} spends heavily.
ev_locust_larvae_opt2_desc: Raise altars and have the people burn incense against them.
ev_locust_larvae_res2: The swarm swells, grain prices leap, and hunger shows in the faces of {kingdom}.
ev_crop_blight_desc: Green fields yellow in patches, roots all gone black; the agronomists {king} sends report a blight at work.
ev_crop_blight_opt1_desc: Burn the sick stands and sow hardier grain.
ev_crop_blight_res1: Smoke dims the sun but the next wheat is spared; {kingdom} pays no small sum.
ev_crop_blight_opt2_desc: Issue no policy; only sell grain cheaply to steady prices.
ev_crop_blight_res2: The blight fades of itself, the harvest is a little light, and the folk of {kingdom} forget.
ev_orchard_wilt_desc: The orchards sicken at once and the fruit drops unripe; {king} sighs that they carry the revenue of {kingdom}.
ev_orchard_wilt_opt1_desc: Cut down the sick old trees and buy young stock.
ev_orchard_wilt_res1: New saplings stand in rows with hope for next year, and the cost of {kingdom} goes with them.
ev_orchard_wilt_opt2_desc: Teach the folk to scrape the sick bark and dress it with ash.
ev_orchard_wilt_res2: Seven or eight trees in ten recover, the growers cope, and the treasury of {kingdom} is spared.
ev_cattle_pest_desc: Draft oxen sicken and die in turn; with spring plowing at hand, {king} sends riders seeking healers.
ev_cattle_pest_opt1_desc: Spend silver on oxen and pen the sick beasts apart.
ev_cattle_pest_res1: Enough oxen, plowing as usual; {kingdom} pays dear prices and spends silver.
ev_cattle_pest_opt2_desc: Slay the cattle to placate the gods, praying the pest abates.
ev_cattle_pest_res2: Fewer oxen, ever hastier plowing; the people blame {king} for wasting the draft beasts.
ev_well_poison_desc: Several wells turn strange and drinkers sicken violently; {king} seals them and bars the lanes, but rumor already runs.
ev_well_poison_opt1_desc: Bail out the water, dose it with lime, send physicians on rounds.
ev_well_poison_res1: The water runs clear again, the sick recover, and {kingdom} pays for the physic.
ev_well_poison_opt2_desc: Suspect foul play and torture those who pass.
ev_well_poison_res2: The innocent suffer and the true hand escapes; everyone in {kingdom} looks over a shoulder.
ev_roof_snow_desc: Heavy snow crushes the homes and collapses the stores; {king} rides out and finds snow waist-deep.
ev_roof_snow_opt1_desc: Hire the folk to shovel the snow and patch the roofs.
ev_roof_snow_res1: Homes are saved and the stricken find lodgings, though {kingdom} cannot avoid the outlay.
ev_roof_snow_opt2_desc: Decree the folk clear their own snow, with fines for the late.
ev_roof_snow_res2: Grumbling, the folk dig furiously; the damage stays light.
ev_glacier_melt_desc: The glacier above breaks and melts, and the snowmelt suddenly swells; {king} sees the valley hamlets in peril.
ev_glacier_melt_opt1_desc: Raise banks to guide the water and move the low-lying folk.
ev_glacier_melt_res1: The hamlets hold and the people resettle in peace; {kingdom} spends much of the public purse.
ev_glacier_melt_opt2_desc: Say the glacier's doing is heaven's, beyond your care.
ev_glacier_melt_res2: The flood breaks the villages, grievance fills the roads, and {kingdom} loses its eastern borderlands.
ev_sea_riser_desc: The sea climbs year by year and the fat fields grow briny; patrolling the dike, {king} sees salt crusting the grain.
ev_sea_riser_opt1_desc: Raise the rampart and skim the salt, storing sweet water.
ev_sea_riser_res1: The brine recedes and crops are saved, at vast cost for the dike works of {kingdom}.
ev_sea_riser_opt2_desc: Bid the folk quit the coast and let the tide take it.
ev_sea_riser_res2: Villagers will not leave their soil; they band together and resist, and the coast of {kingdom} seethes.
ev_dust_death_desc: Black dust veils the sky and will not clear for days; men and beasts cough blood. {king} has the dead carried out, and the healers stand helpless.
ev_dust_death_opt1_desc: Treat the sick, hand out physic, bid the folk cover their mouths.
ev_dust_death_res1: The sickness eases and fewer cough blood, though {kingdom} pays out the treasury beyond all count.
ev_dust_death_opt2_desc: Expel the ailing beyond the walls and bolt the gates.
ev_dust_death_res2: The sick perish in the fields and the rest flee in panic; the heart of {kingdom} scatters.
ev_earthquake_fissure_desc: A great quake splits the ground a hundred miles; houses sink in. From the tower {king} hears the city's wailing.
ev_earthquake_fissure_opt1_desc: Hire crews to fill the rift, raise bridges, take in refugees.
ev_earthquake_fissure_res1: The chasm slowly closes and refugees return to work, while the treasury of {kingdom} runs hollow.
ev_earthquake_fissure_opt2_desc: Conceal the disaster and keep refugees out of the city.
ev_earthquake_fissure_res2: The truth never reaches the court; starving bands howl in the wilds, and {kingdom} turns wild.
ev_ash_cloud_desc: A distant mountain erupts and ash hides the sun three days; {king} hears the crops are blanketed and many throats are sick.
ev_ash_cloud_opt1_desc: Hire hands to rinse the grain and give physic for the throats.
ev_ash_cloud_res1: The ash lifts from the grain and the sick recover, as the costs of {kingdom} pile like the cloud.
ev_ash_cloud_opt2_desc: Shut the palace against the ash and rebuke the people's clamor.
ev_ash_cloud_res2: Ash reaches the homes and illness follows; the people accuse {king} of sitting still and offering no help.
ev_forest_fire_desc: Fire rises from the northern woods, red flame leaping sky-high; {king} sees beasts burst into the city and knows the blaze is strong.
ev_forest_fire_opt1_desc: Fell a corridor to stop the fire, hiring workers with silver.
ev_forest_fire_res1: The fire dies at the break, a third of the wood lost; {kingdom} pays beyond counting.
ev_forest_fire_opt2_desc: Drive the people to fight while the court shields its halls.
ev_forest_fire_res2: The homes burn and the people cry that {king} counts them like chaff.
ev_ice_storm_desc: Freezing rain falls all night and glazes every branch; {king} sees limbs snapped and all travel stopped.
ev_ice_storm_opt1_desc: Send crews to chop the ice, spread salt, reopen the trade.
ev_ice_storm_res1: The roads open and the market revives, at no light cost in salt and silver; caravans pass through {kingdom} again.
ev_ice_storm_opt2_desc: Shut the market a while and wait for the skies to clear.
ev_ice_storm_res2: In days the ice thaws and the gates reopen; {kingdom} has only lost the empty hours.
ev_thunder_harvest_desc: At wheat-ripeness thunder, rain and hail strike sudden; {king} sees the new grain leveled and sparrows feasting in the fields.
ev_thunder_harvest_opt1_desc: Hire reapers to save the flattened wheat and lend seed from the stores.
ev_thunder_harvest_res1: Half the crop survives and seed is secured, while the silver of {kingdom} follows.
ev_thunder_harvest_opt2_desc: Scold the rites as impious, strip the priests of their pay.
ev_thunder_harvest_res2: The priests resent and the villages buzz, all calling {king} a madman; the storms of {kingdom} grow wilder.
ev_famine_seed_desc: The harvest is thin and the granaries empty by the day; {king} hears of wanderers gleaning husks along the road and grieves.
ev_famine_seed_opt1_desc: Open the stores, sell at fair price, send envoys to the realms.
ev_famine_seed_res1: Neighbors send corn and the folk eat a little, yet the hunger has not left, and a great dearth may come with autumn.
ev_famine_seed_opt2_desc: Ban grain from leaving, let prices climb, feed the court city first.
ev_famine_seed_res2: Prices fly up and famished crowds rise; the great famine may well sprout from this.
ev_famine_full_desc: Famine rages and the dead line the roads; {king} cuts the fare and silences the music, yet the weeping still reaches the court.
ev_famine_full_opt1_desc: Send out every store and post officials to open porridge kitchens.
ev_famine_full_res1: Fewer die, yet the treasury of {kingdom} stands empty and next year's reserve is spent.
ev_famine_full_opt2_desc: Bid the hungry scatter and seek lands where corn remains.
ev_famine_full_res2: Refugees choke the roads, plunder rings out, and bandits swarm across {kingdom}.
ev_storm_ruin_desc: Storm and rain flatten hut and tower; {king} sees the granary roofs flying and knows the grain is damaged.
ev_storm_ruin_opt1: Save the grain, aid the folk
ev_storm_ruin_opt1_desc: Hire hands to dry the grain and spend silver on the homes.
ev_storm_ruin_res1: Seven parts of grain survive and the homes mend, at a very heavy cost for {kingdom}.
ev_storm_ruin_opt2_desc: Decree the folk repair their own roofs; the court keeps out.
ev_storm_ruin_res2: The poor sleep under open skies and seethe; crowds raid the granaries, and {kingdom} begins to fall apart.
ev_plague_carrier_desc: The border post reports a trader carrying plague across; {king} goes pale — such fevers kill nine in ten.
ev_plague_carrier_opt1_desc: Seal the pass, raise a lazar-house, send physicians and medicine.
ev_plague_carrier_res1: The plague stays out and hearts steady; the pass-garrisons and drugs cost {kingdom} dear.
ev_plague_carrier_opt2_desc: Fear the trade halt, hide the plague, let him through.
ev_plague_carrier_res2: The plague enters the city, dread grips the streets, and {kingdom} fills with fury.
ev_rat_wave_desc: Great rats swarm by night and gnaw the bins; {king} sees sacks turned to nests, stamps his foot and sighs.
ev_rat_wave_opt1_desc: Buy the rats for silver and have the folk stop the holes.
ev_rat_wave_res1: The vermin ease and the stored corn is safe; {kingdom} pays out the bounty.
ev_rat_wave_opt2_desc: Suspect the folk shelter the rats; jail and question them.
ev_rat_wave_res2: Wronged cries fill the prison while the rats grow wilder; all {kingdom} looks askance.
ev_harvest_rot_desc: The harvest is stored, yet within days the grain is all mold; {king} inspects the store and sees black mold like wool.
ev_harvest_rot_opt1_desc: Hire hands to turn and air it, burning all the moldy part.
ev_harvest_rot_res1: Seven parts of grain saved and the stores smell fresh, though the labor costs {kingdom} dear.
ev_harvest_rot_opt2_desc: Move the grain to drier vaults and let the rest rot.
ev_harvest_rot_res2: The moldy is thrown, the sound is unharmed, and {kingdom} passes the matter without a ripple.
ev_crop_ice_desc: Night frost falls sudden and turns the young fields black; {king} sees the hoar still clinging, and his heart is cut with a knife.
ev_crop_ice_opt1_desc: Lend seed for a new sowing and set up porridge tents.
ev_crop_ice_res1: Green returns, none must wander, and the silver of {kingdom} naturally goes.
ev_crop_ice_opt2_desc: Call the frost heaven's will and scold the folk for idleness.
ev_crop_ice_res2: The people mutter and shift blame on one another; the fields of {kingdom} grow unsettled.
ev_storm_tide_desc: Sea-wind whips the waves and the tide climbs over the dike; {king} sees salt flats drowned and a boat hanging on a rooftop.
ev_storm_tide_opt1_desc: Heighten the seawall and lodge the ousted salt-folk.
ev_storm_tide_res1: The salt flats recover and the people rest, though {kingdom} pays for the dike.
ev_storm_tide_opt2_desc: Drive the salt-folk to throw beasts into the sea, to fear the tide-god.
ev_storm_tide_res2: The salt-folk are ruined and the tide unmoved; their curses swell like the flood.
ev_rain_delayed_desc: The rains come not in rain-season and the shoots curl; {king} prays for rain as custom bids — the sky answers nothing.
ev_rain_delayed_opt1_desc: Spend silver on ditches and water-wheels to save the shoots.
ev_rain_delayed_res1: The seedlings are saved and the fields fill, while silver and rice alike dwindle in the stores of {kingdom}.
ev_rain_delayed_opt2_desc: Seize the witch and burn her in the fields to move the sky.
ev_rain_delayed_res2: The sky stays dry while the people raise their voices; the cruel name of {king} spreads abroad.
ev_grass_fire_desc: A great drought brings no rain and the pasture ignites itself; {king} hears the cattle bolt and sees smoke cover the plains.
ev_grass_fire_opt1_desc: Hire crews to cut firebreaks and split the herds apart.
ev_grass_fire_res1: The fire stops at the line and the herds are whole, at whatever the hired work cost {kingdom}.
ev_grass_fire_opt2_desc: Let the fire burn its course and keep men away.
ev_grass_fire_res2: The fire runs three days and dies; the ash is rich enough to feed the grass.
ev_river_ice_desc: Hard winter locks the great river and the grain barges stand still; {king} sees prices waver and merchants watch.
ev_river_ice_opt1_desc: Hire the folk to chop a channel for the boats.
ev_river_ice_res1: The river-grain flows again and prices fall, while {kingdom} is hard pressed for the ice-cutting costs.
ev_river_ice_opt2_desc: Yield to the river and order the barge-fleet to mark time.
ev_river_ice_res2: In spring the ice gives and the barges resume; prices in {kingdom} rise a little, yet all is calm.
ev_mill_guild_desc: The millers crowd around {king}'s granary, quarreling over shares of the stones, and threaten to shut the mill if profit fails.
ev_mill_guild_opt1_desc: Fat margins quiet the guild; flour prices settle.
ev_mill_guild_res1: Higher pay restarts the mills; foreign markets praise {kingdom}'s fair dealing.
ev_mill_guild_opt2_desc: Force the guild to heel; stalled stones may bring street unrest.
ev_mill_guild_res2: The millers walk off in fury; bread prices soar and the streets grumble.
ev_tailor_march_desc: Feather-capped tailors parade the streets to beg {king} for the tailoring monopoly; their crowd blocks the market gate.
ev_tailor_march_opt1_desc: Treasury silver buys the guild's joy; the cloth market opens as usual.
ev_tailor_march_res1: Pensions paid, silks fill the streets; merchants praise {kingdom}'s kindness to craftsmen.
ev_tailor_march_opt2_desc: Guards scatter the march; the cloth trade may boil over.
ev_tailor_march_res2: The crowd is routed, shops shut; embers of unrest glimmer in the lanes.
ev_smith_guild_desc: The smiths bank their forges and wait, pressing {king} to raise weapons prices; the anvil song dies in one night.
ev_smith_guild_opt1_desc: Priced up, the forges roar again.
ev_smith_guild_res1: Forges rekindle; the nations feel {kingdom}'s honest regard for craftsmen.
ev_smith_guild_opt2_desc: New statutes, new master — the smiths grumble, forges stay dark.
ev_smith_guild_res2: The master is expelled, the forges shut; a mutter of unrest stirs the town.
ev_guild_monopoly_desc: Three guilds corner the markets of {kingdom}: goods may only change hands at guild prices, and the townsfolk cry out.
ev_guild_monopoly_opt1_desc: Tax the fixed prices; the treasury swells, the townsfolk feel it.
ev_guild_monopoly_res1: Tax silver pours in and the monopoly hardens — yet talk grows loud; a backlash is brewing.
ev_guild_monopoly_opt2_desc: The crown outlaws the price pact; the guilds bristle, the market stirs.
ev_guild_monopoly_res2: The ban is out; prices jump wildly, and unrest flares through the lanes.
ev_guild_strike_desc: The guild shuts the market with locked shops and empty stalls — {king} weighs cracking down or making peace.
ev_guild_strike_opt1_desc: Guards reopen the market; strikers face them down the street.
ev_guild_strike_res1: The market opens by force; stalls are smashed and turmoil follows.
ev_guild_strike_opt2_desc: Talk with the masters; trade small favors for reopening.
ev_guild_strike_res2: On reopening day, foreign merchants praise {kingdom}'s temperate mercy.
ev_street_lamp_desc: Dusk grows heavy and burglaries spread; wardens beg {king} to fund more street lamps — no small winter cost.
ev_street_lamp_opt1_desc: Pay from the treasury; every street burns bright.
ev_street_lamp_res1: Lamps burn till dawn; thieves vanish and the night lanes grow calm.
ev_street_lamp_opt2_desc: Lamps can wait; table it until next month.
ev_street_lamp_res2: No lamps, more thefts; the people whisper of a stingy crown.
ev_schooling_plan_desc: Scholars and merchants petition {king} to found village schools, but the sum required is staggering.
ev_schooling_plan_opt1_desc: The treasury pays; reading will ring through the alleys.
ev_schooling_plan_res1: Schools open, children learn; the literati hail {kingdom}'s new age of learning.
ev_schooling_plan_opt2_desc: The granaries are thin; shelve the school plan.
ev_schooling_plan_res2: Pupils despair, scholars gather; grumbling rises through the lanes.
ev_surgery_house_desc: A wandering barber-surgeon begs {king} to endow a surgery house — cut and bone-setting, at no small treasury cost.
ev_surgery_house_opt1_desc: Silver for the house; the surgeon vows to serve.
ev_surgery_house_res1: The house opens; broken bones mend and praises ring through town.
ev_surgery_house_opt2_desc: Cutting flesh shocks custom; the crown declines for now.
ev_surgery_house_res2: No house, no surgery; the wounded turn to charms, and the town sighs.
ev_bath_fee_desc: Baths swarm with traffic; a revenue clerk whispers to {king}: two coppers per bath would fatten the crown.
ev_bath_fee_opt1_desc: One copper a bath: the till fills, no grumbling.
ev_bath_fee_res1: The levy runs; the treasury swells, bathers still come and go.
ev_bath_fee_opt2_desc: Double the levy; bathers stay away and the town objects.
ev_bath_fee_res2: Under the harsh tax the baths empty and townsfolk gather to riot.
ev_beggar_raid_desc: The wealth gap has widened long enough; vagrants swarm the town and seize grain, the market is aghast, and {king} must answer.
ev_beggar_raid_opt1_desc: Hunt the heads, cut them down; the rest scatter, resentment gathers.
ev_beggar_raid_res1: The ringleaders die, but hunger stokes fury and street turmoil follows.
ev_beggar_raid_opt2_desc: Hand out grain from the stores; the treasury takes the loss.
ev_beggar_raid_res2: Grain is doled out, the hungry melt away, and the market finds peace.
ev_orphan_home_desc: Winter nears; orphans and old beggars sleep under the bridge, and the ward prefect begs {king} for a home in mercy.
ev_orphan_home_opt1_desc: Silver grounds a home: clothes, porridge, and shelter for all.
ev_orphan_home_res1: The destitute find shelter; cold bones under the bridge thin out, and hearts settle.
ev_orphan_home_opt2_desc: Bid the parishes to care; the crown spends not a coin.
ev_orphan_home_res2: Parishes shuffle the duty; orphans still shiver in frost and snow.
ev_widow_fund_desc: Over a hundred widows of the fallen, children at their skirts, ask {king} for relief and a settled law to soothe the army.
ev_widow_fund_opt1_desc: A little silver per household, enough to blunt hunger and cold.
ev_widow_fund_res1: The thin relief reaches the widows; brows ease, talk stays muted.
ev_widow_fund_opt2_desc: Endow a grand charity hall for orphans — fame reaching beyond the seas.
ev_widow_fund_res2: The hall stands; envoys of every state praise {kingdom}'s compassionate spirit.
ev_madman_case_desc: A maniac with an axe by the market has cut down several folk; the crowd trembles, and word races to {king}.
ev_madman_case_opt1_desc: Justice on the spot: the axe falls before the crowd.
ev_madman_case_res1: The blood is barely dry before riots break out by the stalls.
ev_madman_case_opt2_desc: Chain him in a cell, call a physician, and wait for sanity.
ev_madman_case_res2: The madman is caged, the axe-threat ends, and the market settles.
ev_rumor_wave_desc: Whispers spread that {kingdom}'s royal stores are empty and taxes will rise; rumor gusts through the lanes and rice jumps first.
ev_rumor_wave_opt1_desc: The whisper swells; every lane adds its own spice.
ev_rumor_wave_res1: Panic ferments; villagers crowd the streets and turmoil rises.
ev_rumor_wave_opt2_desc: Publish the facts, refute the rumor, show the true grain stocks.
ev_rumor_wave_res2: The edict lands; the whispers fade, and the town breathes easier.
ev_book_market_desc: Scholars gather from every land with rare manuscripts, begging {king} to open a book market and spread letters abroad.
ev_book_market_opt1_desc: Clear the ground, gather books free; scholars throng.
ev_book_market_res1: The fair opens; copies travel far, and foreign minds turn to {kingdom}.
ev_book_market_opt2_desc: A fair costs more than it earns; bid them disperse and wait.
ev_book_market_res2: The gathering disperses; scholars sigh, and the plan sleeps.
ev_playhouse_desc: A famous troupe stages a new play and the whole town pours out to watch; the actors beg {king} for a grander house.
ev_playhouse_opt1_desc: Treasury funds the renovation; music rings till dawn.
ev_playhouse_res1: The new stage opens to waves of spectators; the town hums louder.
ev_playhouse_opt2_desc: No curbs, no curfew; the cries of the crowd roll through the night.
ev_playhouse_res2: The crowd boils over; rival fans brawl and riots break out at the doors.
ev_festival_curfew_desc: The lantern night nears; word says thieves mean to move. {king} must choose: curfew, or let the people revel.
ev_festival_curfew_opt1_desc: Lamps out, extra watch; the people lose their joy.
ev_festival_curfew_res1: Under the curfew, complaints fill the lanes and unrest stirs.
ev_festival_curfew_opt2_desc: Lift both curfew and watch; let them sing till dawn.
ev_festival_curfew_res2: Trees of fire, flowers of silver: envoys of all states envy {kingdom}'s festal spirit.
ev_boat_regatta_desc: Dragon Boat Day nears; crews ready their oars. {king} may fund a local race or invite foreign rivals to the river.
ev_boat_regatta_opt1_desc: Treasury backs the race; dragon boats launch, drums shake the shore.
ev_boat_regatta_res1: The regatta ends in cheers; the waterfront has never seen such joy.
ev_boat_regatta_opt2_desc: Letters summon foreign fleets; the victor takes a rich prize.
ev_boat_regatta_res2: Envoys pull the oars; every state praises {kingdom}'s bold grace, and friendship deepens.
ev_flower_walk_desc: The Flower Festival opens; the city walks the green. Officers beg {king} for a flower feast — and foreign guests.
ev_flower_walk_opt1_desc: Wine and flowers; the whole town strolls in bright dresses.
ev_flower_walk_res1: The feast ends; spring deepens, and the town is glad.
ev_flower_walk_opt2_desc: Ask foreign envoys to walk among the blossoms.
ev_flower_walk_res2: The envoys return delighted; nations linger over {kingdom}'s spring.
ev_wedding_boom_desc: Weddings sweep {kingdom}: betrothal gifts and feasts grow lavish, the silk-and-wine trades grow fat, and officers ask for a tax.
ev_wedding_boom_opt1_desc: A clerk at the wedding market; a light levy fills the till.
ev_wedding_boom_res1: The boom swells, the levy grows, and the treasury fills.
ev_wedding_boom_opt2_desc: Let the custom run; no court hand in betrothal or feast.
ev_wedding_boom_res2: The custom endures, the market hums, the till neither grows nor shrinks.
ev_funeral_custom_desc: Rich funerals paper the roads with paper horses and shroud the town; the poor ruin themselves in imitation — {king} hears.
ev_funeral_custom_opt1_desc: Allow the grand display as filial piety; it becomes the fashion.
ev_funeral_custom_res1: All outdo the last funeral; the poor pawn their fields and murmurs rise.
ev_funeral_custom_opt2_desc: Custom is not for the court to pry into; let it pass.
ev_funeral_custom_res2: The pomp continues; the poor still pawn fields and houses, and the court sighs.
ev_food_contest_desc: Master cooks gather to duel in flavor; aroma fills the town. {king} may fund a feast — or host foreign guests.
ev_food_contest_opt1_desc: Silver for the board; the cooks perform, half the town delights.
ev_food_contest_res1: The dishes duel and linger three days; praise rings through town.
ev_food_contest_opt2_desc: A great spread; envoys of every state taste the five flavors.
ev_food_contest_res2: The envoys leave tipsy; every state covets {kingdom}'s culinary art.
ev_night_market_desc: An officer bids {king} keep the market open till the third watch: trade will swell and tax flow — yet brawls may follow.
ev_night_market_opt1_desc: Curfew relaxes; the lantern-lit market hums, every good for sale.
ev_night_market_res1: The night market thrives, tax silver pours in, and {kingdom}'s trade roars.
ev_night_market_opt2_desc: No reins on the night: gambling, juggling, din till dawn.
ev_night_market_res2: Drunk brawls fill the lanes, watchmen swamped, disorder rules.
ev_water_taxi_desc: Canals thread the town but boats are few. Someone begs {king} to license ferries: three coppers a head, the crown takes its share.
ev_water_taxi_opt1_desc: Permit small boats to ply; three coppers tax per crossing.
ev_water_taxi_res1: Boats weave like looms; fees enter the tax, and the canals turn busy.
ev_water_taxi_opt2_desc: Keep the crown ferries; no private boats allowed.
ev_water_taxi_res2: The old ferries keep; the boatmen grumble and crossings flag.
ev_chimney_cleaner_desc: Soot thickens in the chimneys and fires burst out; one begs {king} for a sweep service, charged per house.
ev_chimney_cleaner_opt1_desc: A sweep service, paid per house, the crown takes its share.
ev_chimney_cleaner_res1: Chimneys clean, fires fade, and the fees fill the coffer.
ev_chimney_cleaner_opt2_desc: No service; let each house sweep itself.
ev_chimney_cleaner_res2: Houses sweep as they please; fires come and go, nothing changes.
ev_brew_wave_desc: A sweet new brew; alehouses overflow. {king} may tax the drink to enrich the state — or fear the drunkards.
ev_brew_wave_opt1_desc: Register the taverns, tax the ale; each cask pays the crown.
ev_brew_wave_res1: The levy runs; gold flows daily, and the town carouses in order.
ev_brew_wave_opt2_desc: Lift the old wine bans; let them drink till dawn.
ev_brew_wave_res2: Drunkards sprawl in the lanes, fists fly, and riots repeat.
ev_silk_weavers_desc: The weavers finish a bolt of cloud-brocade, five colors blazing like the Milky Way, and ask {king} to gift it abroad.
ev_silk_weavers_opt1_desc: Choose the finest bolt, pack it, and gift it to foreign courts.
ev_silk_weavers_res1: Brocade envoys fan out; every state marvels at {kingdom}'s craft, and friendship deepens.
ev_silk_weavers_opt2_desc: Heaven-woven stuff; keep it in the palace to admire.
ev_silk_weavers_res2: The brocade enters the palace; the weavers are paid, but the fame stays home.
ev_paper_dealers_desc: Paper runs dear; the stationers form a guild and offer {king} a new tax for the right to fix prices.
ev_paper_dealers_opt1_desc: Let the guild set prices; the crown takes two on the paper.
ev_paper_dealers_res1: The paper tax flows in, prices steady, and the coffer fattens.
ev_paper_dealers_opt2_desc: No guild for the stationers; let paper find its own price.
ev_paper_dealers_res2: Paper prices seesaw; the bookshops grumble, and the court turns a deaf ear.
ev_potters_quarrel_desc: Two kiln-houses fight over one furnace; apprentices hurl tiles — the market is aghast, and word races to {king}.
ev_potters_quarrel_opt1_desc: Say nothing; let the two houses settle it themselves.
ev_potters_quarrel_res1: Tiles fly; half the lane is wrecked and turmoil spreads.
ev_potters_quarrel_opt2_desc: Rule by the kiln deed, fine both houses, and bid them stop.
ev_potters_quarrel_res2: The ruling stands; the houses drop their tiles and the potteries fall quiet.
ev_lamp_oil_desc: Long winter nights; the lantern oil runs short. The warden begs {king} to buy oil, or the streets go black and thieves gather.
ev_lamp_oil_opt1_desc: Treasury buys oil; the lanterns relight, the long street glows.
ev_lamp_oil_res1: Lamps burn all night; the people rejoice and night walkers multiply.
ev_lamp_oil_opt2_desc: Cut the oil; at night the town is black and shadows slide.
ev_lamp_oil_res2: Lights out, thieves in the dark lanes; angry townsfolk gather to riot.
ev_salt_caravan_desc: Salt-road camel bells ring: a caravan asks passage through {kingdom}. Take a heavy toll — or light, as neighborly grace.
ev_salt_caravan_opt1_desc: Tax each salt lot passing; the treasury sees the gain at once.
ev_salt_caravan_res1: Salt silver piles up; {kingdom}'s coffer runs full to the brim.
ev_salt_caravan_opt2_desc: A light toll, open the road, and win foreign hearts.
ev_salt_caravan_res2: Salt stays cheap and the road stays open; every state sings {kingdom}'s friendship.
ev_spice_spree_desc: Merchant ships land pepper and cloves; the rich race to buy, and the tax clerk whispers to {king} of profit.
ev_spice_spree_opt1_desc: Tax pepper and clove at the gate; the spice market erupts.
ev_spice_spree_res1: The dues run; the coffer fills with coin, and feasts grow grander.
ev_spice_spree_opt2_desc: Spices are trifles; let the merchants trade, no dues.
ev_spice_spree_res2: The spice lane runs free; prices carouse and the crown takes nothing.
ev_street_show_desc: Street artists walk the rope and swallow fire; crowds wall in. Give them silver for a stage — or invite foreign eyes.
ev_street_show_opt1_desc: Treasury builds the stage; the band strikes up, show follows show.
ev_street_show_res1: Show follows show; the lanes rejoice and praise the royal grace.
ev_street_show_opt2_desc: Wine and bunting; envoys of the states watch the show.
ev_street_show_res2: Envoys applaud in wonder; the states gossip warmly of {kingdom}'s joyful folk.
ev_temple_market_desc: The old temple fair lies weedy. {king} may revive it for revenue — or welcome pilgrims from foreign states.
ev_temple_market_opt1_desc: Reopen the fair; incense and trinkets all pay a tithe.
ev_temple_market_res1: The fair reopens under incense clouds; dues flow daily into the coffer.
ev_temple_market_opt2_desc: Call pilgrims from the states: three days and nights of rites.
ev_temple_market_res2: Pilgrims throng; every state says {kingdom}'s temple and people fit well.
ev_communal_well_desc: The west well is silted shut; in the summer drought, water is gold. Elders beg {king} to clear it for the people.
ev_communal_well_opt1_desc: Hire the crews: clear the silt, mend the walls, dig deeper.
ev_communal_well_res1: Clear water gushes; the streets drink and {kingdom}'s people feel the grace.
ev_communal_well_opt2_desc: Bid the wardens make the people dredge; the till stays untouched.
ev_communal_well_res2: The dredge stalls midway; when drought comes, the wrangling at the well returns.
ev_bridge_toll_desc: The new bridge stands and merchants throng it. {king} may set a toll to fill the coffers — or dread the wrath it stirs.
ev_bridge_toll_opt1_desc: A post at the bridge, a fee on every load; the treasury rises at once.
ev_bridge_toll_res1: The toll stands; merchants flow as the river, and the coffer grows solid.
ev_bridge_toll_opt2_desc: Double the fee; merchants halt at the bank, and complaints boil.
ev_bridge_toll_res2: Carts reroute, the tollmen stand idle, and popular fury thickens into riot.
ev_neighbor_dispute_desc: Two neighbors fight over a three-foot eaves line; half the lane suffers, the warden is helpless, and all wait on {king}.
ev_neighbor_dispute_opt1_desc: Deed or no, both houses are flogged — twenty strokes each.
ev_neighbor_dispute_res1: Both houses cry foul, neighbors protest, and the lane turns restless.
ev_neighbor_dispute_opt2_desc: Send surveyors, measure and set stones, end the quarrel.
ev_neighbor_dispute_res2: The boundary stones stand; both houses yield, cooking smoke rises again, and the neighbors approve.
ev_house_rent_desc: House rents double and double again; laborers sleep under the bridge and their fury boils — {king} fumes, knowing a ban is hard.
ev_house_rent_opt1_desc: Rents follow the market; the court stays out, tenants suffer.
ev_house_rent_res1: Tenants can bear no more; they riot in crowds, the bridge fills, and the town roils.
ev_house_rent_opt2_desc: Issue a rule, record fair rents, and punish the greedy.
ev_house_rent_res2: The cap holds; rents ease, workers find rest, and the town approves.
ev_harvest_dance_desc: Five grains ripen and the storehouses overflow; villagers sing to the pot-drum, asking {king} to feast the harvest with the nations.
ev_harvest_dance_opt1_desc: A thousand-seat feast, pot-drums rolling, villagers drinking deep.
ev_harvest_dance_res1: The feast opens, the people rejoice, and the fat year rings through the lands.
ev_harvest_dance_opt2_desc: Golden letters fly out; envoys come to toast the harvest.
ev_harvest_dance_res2: Envoys raise their cups together, all praising {kingdom}'s bounteous skies.
ev_witch_case_desc: A village witch is accused of spreading curses; the crowd cries for death, though some scholars whisper of a frame-up.
ev_witch_case_opt1_desc: Heed the crowd: burn the witch in public to purge the evil.
ev_witch_case_res1: As the fire rises, the crowd turns grim; by next day riots wander the market.
ev_witch_case_opt2_desc: Deem the charge false, cane the slanderers, call the physician, and let her go home.
ev_witch_case_res2: The witch walks free; neighbor states hear it and praise {kingdom}'s lenient justice.
ev_border_stone_desc: A new boundary stone rises in the pass; the neighbors squabble over a few feet of land and folk grow uneasy.
ev_border_stone_opt1_desc: Yield nothing; armed men guard the stone.
ev_border_stone_res1: The standoff drags on; {kingdom} loses standing among nations.
ev_border_stone_opt2_desc: Concede a few feet and turn swords into silk.
ev_border_stone_res2: Magnanimity spreads; nations look on {kingdom} with new respect.
ev_fishing_spat_desc: The border river teems with fish; both fleets race to cast nets while crowds watch — a clash is brewing.
ev_fishing_spat_opt1_desc: Drive the neighbor vessels away and keep the whole season.
ev_fishing_spat_res1: The neighbor boats retreat in fury; the border river brews trouble.
ev_fishing_spat_opt2_desc: Agree on closed seasons and stagger the casts.
ev_fishing_spat_res2: The catch is shared; laughter echoes on both banks.
ev_hunt_line_desc: Hunters of both realms chase game across the border ridges; bows are drawn before any spoor is found.
ev_hunt_line_opt1_desc: Send hunting parties with guards into the neighbor woods.
ev_hunt_line_res1: Hunting horns blare; distrust grows across the border.
ev_hunt_line_opt2_desc: Mark the ridges and hunt only on your side.
ev_hunt_line_res2: With lines clear, hunters no longer cross each other.
ev_hostage_walk_desc: The neighbor heir has lodged in {kingdom} for years; envoys now come to escort him home.
ev_hostage_walk_opt1_desc: Send him off with honors and comforts along the way.
ev_hostage_walk_res1: The carriage rolls west; the neighbor appreciates the grace. The long road home still waits ahead.
ev_hostage_walk_opt2_desc: Delay the departure; keep the heir as a lever.
ev_hostage_walk_res2: The court quarrels; gossip boils in the streets; unease stirs at home.
ev_hostage_return_desc: Next spring the neighbor presses again: {king} must honor the promise and send the heir home.
ev_hostage_return_opt1_desc: Send him home with horses, robes, and goodwill.
ev_hostage_return_res1: The heir returns; trust heals and {kingdom} gains fame for good faith.
ev_hostage_return_opt2_desc: Plead old accounts and ask repayment before release.
ev_hostage_return_res2: The neighbor seethes; court and commons blame {king} for breaking faith.
ev_embassy_swap_desc: The neighbor proposes permanent embassies with {kingdom}, envoys stationed in each capital.
ev_embassy_swap_res1: Envoys shuttle between the courts; old grudges thin out.
ev_embassy_swap_opt2_desc: Plead border troubles and put the matter aside.
ev_embassy_swap_res2: The envoy leaves disappointed; the two courts stay estranged.
ev_state_visit_desc: The neighbor sovereign comes in person to {kingdom}; a fitting welcome would strain the treasury, and the court buzzes.
ev_state_visit_opt1_desc: Banners along the roads, feasts for the army.
ev_state_visit_res1: Gold pours out, but the guest is delighted and the alliance deepens.
ev_state_visit_res2: The sovereign departs; his words are distant.
ev_peace_priest_desc: A wandering monk arrives, offering to mediate old feuds for {king}; the people look on eagerly.
ev_peace_priest_opt1_desc: Seat him in the palace and hear his counsel.
ev_peace_priest_res1: The monk shuttles between the capitals; sword anger turns to incense.
ev_peace_priest_opt2_desc: Suspect espionage and drive him out.
ev_peace_priest_res2: The monk is gone, but the people murmur against {kingdom}.
ev_gift_entourage_desc: The neighbor sends a mission with rare gifts — and a list of requests. How shall {king} reply?
ev_gift_entourage_opt1_desc: Return gifts beyond their sending, spread among the nations.
ev_gift_entourage_res1: The vault thins, yet nations warm to {kingdom}.
ev_gift_entourage_opt2_desc: Match each gift at its listed worth.
ev_salt_pact_desc: Neighbor salt pans failed; cattle for the salt of {kingdom}, and a lasting pact.
ev_salt_pact_opt1_desc: Fix a price and trade for years to come.
ev_salt_pact_res1: The salt road flows; the neighbor holds {kingdom} as a true friend.
ev_salt_pact_opt2_desc: Hoard the salt and sell by quota.
ev_salt_pact_res2: A neighbor year of plain food — the blame falls on {kingdom}.
ev_grain_bridge_desc: The neighbor faces lean months; grain may travel the roads of {kingdom} for a fair price.
ev_grain_bridge_opt1_desc: Sell grain at fair prices, taxes aside.
ev_grain_bridge_res1: Grain wagons stream across; the neighbor praises the warmth of {kingdom}.
ev_grain_bridge_opt2_desc: Fear price rises and watch the passes.
ev_grain_bridge_res2: The neighbor scrapes through, mercifully without grudge.
ev_ship_licence_desc: Neighbor shipmasters seek licences of {kingdom} — gold for the right to sail the seas.
ev_ship_licence_opt1_desc: Collect the fee; let the ships sail on.
ev_ship_licence_res1: The vault fattens; the first fruits of sea trade appear.
ev_ship_licence_opt2_desc: Cap the numbers and demand endless checks.
ev_ship_licence_res2: Ships hold back; neighbor merchants grumble loudly.
ev_ferry_treaty_desc: One river divides the realms; ferries earn unevenly and quarrels continue — the neighbor proposes a charter.
ev_ferry_treaty_opt1_desc: Split the fares and run the crossings together.
ev_ferry_treaty_res1: Travelers praise the ease; border folk grow friendly.
ev_ferry_treaty_opt2_desc: Keep the old ways; each keeps its fares.
ev_ferry_treaty_res2: The crossings stay as they were; squabbles over passage continue.
ev_exile_welcome_desc: Civil strife drives old officials with their kin to the gates of {kingdom}, petitioning as crowds watch.
ev_exile_welcome_opt1_desc: Shelter them, grant fields, enroll them in the registers.
ev_exile_welcome_res1: The exiles settle; nations praise {kingdom} for the old kings' virtue.
ev_exile_welcome_opt2_desc: Order them out; none may shelter them.
ev_exile_welcome_res2: The exiles wail in the fields; the spirit of {kingdom} wavers.
ev_rival_envoy_desc: The old foe sends an envoy; the letter is courteous and may hide designs, and {king} wavers.
ev_rival_envoy_opt1_desc: Throw the letter back and drive him out.
ev_rival_envoy_res1: Satisfying for a moment; nations now deem {kingdom} hotheaded.
ev_rival_envoy_opt2_desc: Feast the envoy and answer courtesy with courtesy.
ev_rival_envoy_res2: Wine dissolves old anger; nations praise {kingdom} for a generous heart.
ev_neutral_pledge_desc: Great powers contest; the neighbor begs {king} to swear neutrality in writing while envoys wait at the gate.
ev_neutral_pledge_opt1_desc: Sign the letter and declare neutrality.
ev_neutral_pledge_res1: The neighbor rests easy; {kingdom} finds quiet too.
ev_neutral_pledge_opt2_desc: Speak in riddles and commit to nothing.
ev_neutral_pledge_res2: The envoy returns; the neighbor doubts but holds back.
ev_betrothal_overture_desc: The neighbor prince admires a princess of {kingdom}; matchmakers come with ornate letters and the palace buzzes.
ev_betrothal_overture_opt1_desc: Accept the betrothal; bind the houses.
ev_betrothal_overture_res1: The red thread is tied; the two realms share close friendship.
ev_betrothal_overture_opt2_desc: Plead tender age and defer the matter.
ev_betrothal_overture_res2: The matchmaker leaves glum, yet the realms stay cordial.
ev_border_market_desc: Border folk petition for a shared market; tolls would benefit crown and people. Will {king} grant it?
ev_border_market_opt1_desc: Set up the toll office and let trade flow.
ev_border_market_res1: The market thrives; tolls fill the chest and life quickens in {kingdom}.
ev_border_market_opt2_desc: Fear troublemakers and shut the crossings.
ev_border_market_res2: The open market is barred, yet smugglers prowl the fields.
ev_trade_embargo_desc: A neighbor caravan risked smuggling and broke the law; ministers urge cutting off its trade while the court argues.
ev_trade_embargo_opt1_desc: Close the gates by decree; halt all caravans.
ev_trade_embargo_res1: The markets wilt; the neighbor bleeds — grievance and anger both grow.
ev_trade_embargo_opt2_desc: Levy a heavy fine, then allow trade again.
ev_trade_embargo_res2: The fine enters the vault, trade resumes; the neighbor calls it fair.
ev_embassy_code_desc: Envoy processions lack fixed rules and quarrels keep breaking out; {king} would issue a code.
ev_embassy_code_opt1_desc: Fix ranks and rites; envoys follow them.
ev_embassy_code_res1: Rites are ordered; embassy traffic takes on new polish.
ev_embassy_code_opt2_desc: No new law; let them do as they please.
ev_embassy_code_res2: Processions shove through streets; citizens glare and gossip boils.
ev_spy_swap_desc: The neighbor captured three agents of {kingdom} and offers their own captives in exchange, saving face both ways.
ev_spy_swap_opt1_desc: Exchange on the border, by unspoken accord.
ev_spy_swap_res1: The agents return; a silent understanding binds the courts.
ev_spy_swap_opt2_desc: Insist there are no agents and refuse the deal.
ev_spy_swap_res2: The envoy leaves glum; the three remain in the neighbor dungeon.
ev_pirate_offer_desc: A pirate band sends a letter asking {king} to let them pay gold in atonement and join the navy; the seas stir.
ev_pirate_offer_opt1_desc: Give them rank and register them in the fleet.
ev_pirate_offer_res1: The seas settle; neighbors feel the merit of {kingdom} in quelling pirates.
ev_pirate_offer_opt2_desc: Collect the gold and let them sail away.
ev_pirate_offer_res2: The ransom fills the vault, but a new gang of rogues rides the waves.
ev_refugee_treaty_desc: War in the neighbor realm sends refugees in floods to the border of {kingdom}; dwellings cannot hold them and officials petition.
ev_refugee_treaty_opt1_desc: Pitch tents, give grain, and settle them in new hamlets.
ev_refugee_treaty_res1: The refugees find homes; nations extol benevolent rule in {kingdom}.
ev_refugee_treaty_opt2_desc: Reinforce the gates; no refugee may enter.
ev_refugee_treaty_res2: Refugees weep below the gates; the folk of {kingdom} grieve too.
ev_river_fishery_desc: The border river yields choice fish; both realms compete as the season nears and boats already hold their sides.
ev_river_fishery_opt1_desc: Stagger the nets; keep set rest seasons.
ev_river_fishery_res1: The catch is shared; the river lawsuits fall silent.
ev_river_fishery_opt2_desc: No pact; every boat on its own skill.
ev_river_fishery_res2: Poaching on both sides; small grudges flare.
ev_mountain_pass_desc: The mountain road between the realms is craggy; the neighbor sends a letter asking to open the plankway for trade.
ev_mountain_pass_opt1_desc: Lend workers for the road; halve the tolls.
ev_mountain_pass_res1: The plankway opens; traders stream along it.
ev_mountain_pass_opt2_desc: Raise toll barriers and deny passage.
ev_mountain_pass_res2: The gate holds, yet neighbor caravans detour and resent the realm.
ev_temple_diplomacy_desc: The neighbor sends monks: let both realms build a shrine on the border mountain and share its incense.
ev_temple_diplomacy_opt1_desc: Give timber and gold; cast the image together.
ev_temple_diplomacy_res1: Monks and laity of both lands bow at one mountain; pilgrims crowd {kingdom}.
ev_temple_diplomacy_opt2_desc: Decline politely; each realm keeps its own rites.
ev_temple_diplomacy_res2: The border mountain stays wild; each realm burns its own incense.
ev_scholar_visit_desc: Learned men bring books, wishing to study classics and calendars with the sages of {kingdom}; the academies take notice.
ev_scholar_visit_opt1_desc: Welcome them to the academy; debate the hard questions.
ev_scholar_visit_res1: Books are exchanged; scholarship of {kingdom} gains fresh fuel.
ev_scholar_visit_res2: The scholars return north in dismay; the two realms keep their learning apart.
ev_doctor_mission_desc: Plague blazes in the neighbor realm; doctors beg aid and rare drugs, asking {king} to send physicians along.
ev_doctor_mission_opt1_desc: Cross with medicines; save the plague-torn people.
ev_doctor_mission_res1: The plague recedes; the neighbor praises the virtue of {king} far and wide.
