ev_doctor_mission_opt2_desc: Tighten pest checks and send no physician.
ev_doctor_mission_res2: The plague stays out, yet the neighbor resents the inaction of {kingdom}.
ev_astronomical_mission_desc: The neighbor asks {king} to let its astronomers ascend the observatory of the realm and co-write a new calendar.
ev_astronomical_mission_opt1_desc: Share the platform and merge the calendars.
ev_astronomical_mission_res1: The new calendar is done; both realms deem it precise.
ev_astronomical_mission_opt2_desc: Heavens are state secrets; decline politely.
ev_astronomical_mission_res2: The envoy returns regretfully; each realm keeps its own calendar.
ev_military_pact_desc: Surrounded by enemies, the neighbor offers {kingdom} a defensive-offensive pact with shared military costs; envoys await.
ev_military_pact_opt1_desc: Pledge mutual aid against common foes.
ev_military_pact_res1: The realms share one foe; nations take notice and the standing of {kingdom} leaps.
ev_military_pact_opt2_desc: Plead difficulty and watch the outcome.
ev_military_pact_res2: Barely holding on, the neighbor resents the inaction of {kingdom}.
ev_naval_truce_desc: Fleets of both realms hold off in far seas and clashes repeat; the neighbor asks for a fixed truce so each sails safe.
ev_naval_truce_opt1_desc: Fix the term and pull back both sides.
ev_naval_truce_res1: The waves settle; merchant ships ply as before.
ev_naval_truce_opt2_desc: Agree openly, then raid in secret with fast ships.
ev_naval_truce_res2: The neighbor senses it and grows wary of {kingdom} in secret rage.
ev_garrison_border_desc: Bandits prowl the border; the neighbor asks {kingdom} to raise a joint garrison and patrol both sides, though pay runs high.
ev_garrison_border_opt1_desc: Fund the garrison and patrol both borders.
ev_garrison_border_res1: Bandits vanish; only the pay of the soldiers thins the treasury.
ev_garrison_border_opt2_desc: No joint pact; watch your own line.
ev_garrison_border_res2: Bandits slip through the seams and stay a border curse.
ev_diplomat_bride_desc: A minister of the neighbor sends a betrothal: a noble daughter for {king} to bind the realms, while all watch.
ev_diplomat_bride_opt1_desc: Raise her to consort rank; both realms rejoice.
ev_diplomat_bride_res1: Wedding joy fills the palace; friendship of the realms turns firm.
ev_diplomat_bride_opt2_desc: Sneer at their station and refuse to their face.
ev_diplomat_bride_res2: The envoy stalks off; court and commons argue, and hearts waver.
ev_insult_word_desc: An envoy of {kingdom} mocked the neighbor king at a banquet; the rude word is now a grievance and the neighbor demands answers.
ev_insult_word_opt1_desc: Call it drunken talk; refuse to inquire.
ev_insult_word_res1: The neighbor harbors the grudge; nations all judge {kingdom} rude.
ev_insult_word_opt2_desc: Punish the envoy; apologize in the state letter.
ev_insult_word_res2: The neighbor relents; a laugh dissolves the old grievance.
ev_gesture_of_peace_desc: A new sovereign on the neighbor throne sends white jade, wishing to end years of feud and reopen the correspondence.
ev_gesture_of_peace_opt1_desc: Accept the jade, renounce the feud, restore goodwill.
ev_gesture_of_peace_res1: The realms lay down arms; the name of {king} rings through the neighbors.
ev_gesture_of_peace_opt2_desc: Take the jade, give no answer; watch for sincerity.
ev_gesture_of_peace_res2: The envoy waits in vain; the new king doubts the will of {king}.
ev_tax_for_trade_desc: The neighbor asks to revise the trade tax: light tariffs steady the market and even raise income; heavy ones drain it.
ev_tax_for_trade_opt1_desc: Lower tariffs to widen trade; income may follow.
ev_tax_for_trade_res1: Caravans gather; taxes swell and the markets of {kingdom} shine anew.
ev_tax_for_trade_opt2_desc: Raise the levies to fill the treasury.
ev_tax_for_trade_res2: Caravans detour; the tax source dries up and the neighbor resents it.
ev_royal_letter_desc: The neighbor king writes {king} in his own hand, with greetings and a gyrfalcon as gift, in a warm style.
ev_royal_letter_opt1_desc: Write back by hand, with sable robes besides.
ev_royal_letter_res1: Letters flow both ways; the two kings come to know each other.
ev_royal_letter_opt2_desc: Let it gather dust; not a word in reply.
ev_royal_letter_res2: The king is displeased, though he shows no color.
ev_currency_pact_desc: Coins of the two realms differ in fineness and exchange ruins trade; the neighbor proposes one standard, merchants hope.
ev_currency_pact_opt1_desc: Cast at one furnace; honor mutual exchange.
ev_currency_pact_res1: One coinage; trade between the realms flows without hindrance.
ev_currency_pact_opt2_desc: Keep the old rules; conversion as before.
ev_currency_pact_res2: Traders still suffer the conversion, yet the realms dwell in peace.
ev_map_dispute_desc: The two maps mark the line differently; border herdsmen sue each other over crossings and offices grow weary.
ev_map_dispute_opt1_desc: Refuse survey; stick to the old chart.
ev_map_dispute_res1: The line stays unsettled; border suits pile like mountains.
ev_map_dispute_opt2_desc: Officials of both sides survey and recut the stones.
ev_map_dispute_res2: New stones set; the herdsmen keep to their pastures.
ev_goodwill_feast_desc: Envoys of many nations gather in {kingdom}; {king} would hold a grand feast to bind them in friendship, kitchens wait.
ev_goodwill_feast_opt1_desc: Set out delicacies of the world; give rich presents.
ev_goodwill_feast_res1: The kitchens cost dear, yet envoys return happy and the realm gains grace.
ev_goodwill_feast_opt2_desc: One frugal table, rites kept to the letter.
ev_goodwill_feast_res2: Rites are complete; only the warmth runs thinner.
ev_embassy_rotation_desc: Embassies long fixed in one place grow into watchposts; {king} would rotate them by term to curb the mischief.
ev_embassy_rotation_opt1_desc: Fix the terms and rotate on schedule.
ev_embassy_rotation_res1: Watchpost mischief thins; embassy traffic runs as usual.
ev_embassy_rotation_opt2_desc: No change; every envoy stays settled.
ev_embassy_rotation_res2: Embassies as before; the watchposts of the nations grow deeper.
ev_world_war_pact_desc: A secret pact leaks among the kingdoms: {kingdom}'s rival and strong neighbor are colluding; war hangs over every throne.
ev_world_war_pact_opt1_desc: Publish the pact; let the war ignite the whole continent.
ev_world_war_pact_res1: The continent burns; {kingdom} is carved into history alongside the smoke.
ev_world_war_pact_opt2_desc: Bury the pact; shore up arms and friendships first.
ev_world_war_pact_res2: The choice draws stares; the war smolders, the undercurrent surges.
ev_world_war_driven_desc: Ore veins and granaries are coveted everywhere; {kingdom}'s scouts report every power is arming.
ev_world_war_driven_opt1_desc: Fire the first shot before the powers ally.
ev_world_war_driven_res1: Continental order collapses; {kingdom} is drawn into an unprecedented melee.
ev_world_war_driven_opt2_desc: Hold; let someone else fire the first shot.
ev_world_war_driven_res2: Observer-calm buys no peace; {kingdom} later gets dragged into the war anyway.
ev_declare_war_casus_desc: Clashes at the border posts; {king}'s generals are inflamed: declare war or hold back?
ev_declare_war_casus_opt1_desc: Seize the pretext; declare war on the strongest neighbor.
ev_declare_war_casus_res1: War drums roll; {kingdom}'s army marches to the neighbor's border.
ev_declare_war_casus_opt2_desc: Apologize and soothe; win the powers' understanding.
ev_declare_war_casus_res2: Restraint wins a good name; the border stays tense.
ev_war_monger_desc: The hawks grow louder in {king}'s court — old grudges are rehashed, urging instant war.
ev_war_monger_opt1_desc: Give the hawks a chance: declare war on the current rival (or strongest enemy).
ev_war_monger_res1: War ignites; {kingdom} is drawn into a war with a strong foe.
ev_war_monger_opt2_desc: Dismiss the hawk generals; reaffirm peace first.
ev_war_monger_res2: The hawks are curbed; powers exhale, and {kingdom}'s image softens.
ev_forced_peace_breaker_desc: An old breach of treaty resurfaces; {king}'s court is inflamed — declare war to avenge, or swallow it.
ev_forced_peace_breaker_opt1_desc: Declare war on the strongest neighbor; make the ledger bleed.
ev_forced_peace_breaker_res1: The declaration arrives; the gears of war mesh again.
ev_forced_peace_breaker_opt2_desc: Endure in silence; let the powers see restraint.
ev_forced_peace_breaker_res2: Swallowing the insult buys trust and time; the neighbor's arrogance grows.
ev_alliance_overture_desc: A neighbor's envoy brings an olive branch to {kingdom} — trade friendship for safety, or decline to keep freedom?
ev_alliance_overture_opt1_desc: Form an alliance with the most amicable neighbor.
ev_alliance_overture_res1: The pact is sealed; the borders of {kingdom} gain weight.
ev_alliance_overture_opt2_desc: See the envoy off; keep an independent posture.
ev_alliance_overture_res2: Declining keeps {kingdom} independent for now — and one ally fewer.
ev_treaty_of_salt_desc: The salt-route dispute lingers; a neighbor proposes a shared-profit treaty, or cold status quo.
ev_treaty_of_salt_opt1_desc: Ally with the strongest neighbor and share the salt profit.
ev_treaty_of_salt_res1: The salt pact holds; trade flows, treasury and allies alike grow.
ev_treaty_of_salt_res2: The salt road stays intermittent; {kingdom}'s independence is impeccable.
ev_enemy_of_enemy_desc: Agents report a kingdom that shares {kingdom}'s rivalry — ally with it, even strike jointly?
ev_enemy_of_enemy_opt1_desc: Ally with the friendliest kingdom and declare war on the strongest neighbor.
ev_enemy_of_enemy_res1: Alliance and declaration go out together; {kingdom}'s game deepens.
ev_enemy_of_enemy_opt2_desc: Ally with the friendliest kingdom; keep the sword sheathed.
ev_enemy_of_enemy_res2: With an ally in hand, {kingdom}'s diplomatic room opens up.
ev_capital_relocate_desc: The old capital decays while another city thrives — {king} must choose: new capital or keep the old?
ev_capital_relocate_opt1_desc: Move the capital to the second city; the old one becomes ordinary.
ev_capital_relocate_res1: The new capital raises the royal flag; the old one sheds its heavy crown.
ev_capital_relocate_opt2_desc: Abandon the move; pour silver into the old capital's repair.
ev_capital_relocate_res2: The old capital is fortified, but traders still grumble about the location.
ev_capital_undaunted_desc: Enemy blades point at {kingdom}'s capital — flee the city, or hold the cradle?
ev_capital_undaunted_opt1_desc: Evacuate; relocate the capital to the second city to preserve the king's aura.
ev_capital_undaunted_res1: The flag moves; the wounds remain on the old walls.
ev_capital_undaunted_opt2_desc: Order a defense to the death; soldiers and people united.
ev_capital_undaunted_res2: Fierce days pass; the capital holds, but treasury and population pay the price.
ev_building_renaissance_desc: Master builders petition for a grand renovation: repair and upgrade buildings across {kingdom}.
ev_building_renaissance_opt1_desc: Fund building upgrades (houses and workshops first).
ev_building_renaissance_res1: Builders work day and night; {kingdom}'s streets look new.
ev_building_renaissance_opt2_desc: Decline the works; keep the coin in the treasury.
ev_building_renaissance_res2: Old buildings still serve, yet {kingdom}'s market shines less.
ev_merchant_tycoon_desc: A tycoon's rise or ruinous gamble shakes {kingdom}'s market — some struck it rich, some lost it all.
ev_merchant_tycoon_opt1_desc: Let capital flow to the boldest traders — they ignite with new wealth.
ev_merchant_tycoon_res1: Capital fever doubles the tycoons' worth and brands the risk.
ev_merchant_tycoon_opt2_desc: Squeeze the bubble; let speculators pay.
ev_merchant_tycoon_res2: A wave of merchants goes bankrupt; {kingdom}'s market gains caution.
